title: The Book of 1 Chronicles Decoded
author: Brittany Johnson
description: The Book of 1 Chronicles — every verse decoded into plain, modern English (DMLV).

verses.kjv: Adam, Sheth, Enosh,
verses.decoded: Adam, Seth, Enosh,

verses.kjv: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jered,
verses.decoded: Kenan, Mahalaleel, Jared,

verses.kjv: Henoch, Methuselah, Lamech,
verses.decoded: Enoch, Methuselah, Lamech,

verses.kjv: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.
verses.decoded: Noah, Shem, Ham, and Japheth.

verses.kjv: The sons of Japheth; Gomer, and Magog, and Madai, and Javan, and Tubal, and Meshech, and Tiras.
verses.decoded: The sons of Japheth were Gomer, Magog, Madai, Javan, Tubal, Meshech, and Tiras.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Gomer; Ashchenaz, and Riphath, and Togarmah.
verses.decoded: The sons of Gomer were Ashchenaz, Riphath, and Togarmah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Javan; Elishah, and Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.
verses.decoded: The sons of Javan were Elishah, Tarshish, Kittim, and Dodanim.

verses.kjv: The sons of Ham; Cush, and Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.
verses.decoded: The sons of Ham were Cush, Mizraim, Put, and Canaan.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Cush; Seba, and Havilah, and Sabta, and Raamah, and Sabtecha. And the sons of Raamah; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.decoded: The sons of Cush were Seba, Havilah, Sabta, Raamah, and Sabtecha. The sons of Raamah were Sheba and Dedan.

verses.kjv: And Cush begat Nimrod: he began to be mighty upon the earth.
verses.decoded: Cush became the father of Nimrod; he started to become powerful on the earth.

verses.kjv: And Mizraim begat Ludim, and Anamim, and Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,
verses.decoded: Mizraim became the father of Ludim, Anamim, Lehabim, and Naphtuhim,

verses.kjv: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, (of whom came the Philistines,) and Caphthorim.
verses.decoded: And Pathrusim, and Casluhim, from whom the Philistines came, and Caphthorim.

verses.kjv: And Canaan begat Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,
verses.decoded: Canaan became the father of Zidon his firstborn, and Heth,

verses.kjv: The Jebusite also, and the Amorite, and the Girgashite,
verses.decoded: The Jebusite, the Amorite, and the Girgashite,

verses.kjv: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,
verses.decoded: And the Hivite, and the Arkite, and the Sinite,

verses.kjv: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.
verses.decoded: And the Arvadite, and the Zemarite, and the Hamathite.

verses.kjv: The sons of Shem; Elam, and Asshur, and Arphaxad, and Lud, and Aram, and Uz, and Hul, and Gether, and Meshech.
verses.decoded: The sons of Shem were Elam, Asshur, Arphaxad, Lud, Aram, Uz, Hul, Gether, and Meshech.

verses.kjv: And Arphaxad begat Shelah, and Shelah begat Eber.
verses.decoded: Arphaxad became the father of Shelah, and Shelah became the father of Eber.

verses.kjv: And unto Eber were born two sons: the name of the one was Peleg; because in his days the earth was divided: and his brother’s name was Joktan.
verses.decoded: Eber had two sons: one was named Peleg, because during his lifetime the earth was divided; and his brother's name was Joktan.

verses.kjv: And Joktan begat Almodad, and Sheleph, and Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,
verses.decoded: Joktan became the father of Almodad, Sheleph, Hazarmaveth, and Jerah,

verses.kjv: Hadoram also, and Uzal, and Diklah,
verses.decoded: Hadoram, Uzal, and Diklah,

verses.kjv: And Ebal, and Abimael, and Sheba,
verses.decoded: Ebal, Abimael, and Sheba,

verses.kjv: And Ophir, and Havilah, and Jobab. All these were the sons of Joktan.
verses.decoded: Ophir, Havilah, and Jobab were all sons of Joktan.

verses.kjv: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,
verses.decoded: Shem, Arphaxad, Shelah,

verses.kjv: Eber, Peleg, Reu,
verses.decoded: Eber, Peleg, Reu,

verses.kjv: Serug, Nahor, Terah,
verses.decoded: Serug, Nahor, Terah,

verses.kjv: Abram; the same is Abraham.
verses.decoded: Abram, who is the same person as Abraham.

verses.kjv: The sons of Abraham; Isaac, and Ishmael.
verses.decoded: The sons of Abraham were Isaac and Ishmael.

verses.kjv: These are their generations: The firstborn of Ishmael, Nebaioth; then Kedar, and Adbeel, and Mibsam,
verses.decoded: These are their descendants: The firstborn of Ishmael was Nebaioth; then Kedar, Adbeel, and Mibsam,

verses.kjv: Mishma, and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,
verses.decoded: Mishma and Dumah, Massa, Hadad, and Tema,

verses.kjv: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.
verses.decoded: Jetur, Naphish, and Kedemah. These are the sons of Ishmael.

verses.kjv: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she bare Zimran, and Jokshan, and Medan, and Midian, and Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan; Sheba, and Dedan.
verses.decoded: Now the sons of Keturah, Abraham’s concubine: she gave birth to Zimran, Jokshan, Medan, Midian, Ishbak, and Shuah. And the sons of Jokshan were Sheba and Dedan.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Midian; Ephah, and Epher, and Henoch, and Abida, and Eldaah. All these are the sons of Keturah.
verses.decoded: The sons of Midian were Ephah, Epher, Henoch, Abida, and Eldaah. All of these were the sons of Keturah.

verses.kjv: And Abraham begat Isaac. The sons of Isaac; Esau and Israel.
verses.decoded: Abraham became the father of Isaac. The sons of Isaac were Esau and Israel.

verses.kjv: The sons of Esau; Eliphaz, Reuel, and Jeush, and Jaalam, and Korah.
verses.decoded: The sons of Esau were Eliphaz, Reuel, Jeush, Jaalam, and Korah.

verses.kjv: The sons of Eliphaz; Teman, and Omar, Zephi, and Gatam, Kenaz, and Timna, and Amalek.
verses.decoded: The sons of Eliphaz were Teman, Omar, Zephi, Gatam, Kenaz, Timna, and Amalek.

verses.kjv: The sons of Reuel; Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.
verses.decoded: The sons of Reuel were Nahath, Zerah, Shammah, and Mizzah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Seir; Lotan, and Shobal, and Zibeon, and Anah, and Dishon, and Ezer, and Dishan.
verses.decoded: The sons of Seir were Lotan, Shobal, Zibeon, Anah, Dishon, Ezar, and Dishan.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Lotan; Hori, and Homam: and Timna was Lotan’s sister.
verses.decoded: The sons of Lotan were Hori and Homam, and Timna was Lotan's sister.

verses.kjv: The sons of Shobal; Alian, and Manahath, and Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. And the sons of Zibeon; Aiah, and Anah.
verses.decoded: The sons of Shobal were Alian, Manahath, Ebal, Shephi, and Onam. The sons of Zibeon were Aiah and Anah.

verses.kjv: The sons of Anah; Dishon. And the sons of Dishon; Amram, and Eshban, and Ithran, and Cheran.
verses.decoded: The sons of Anah were Dishon. The sons of Dishon were Amram, Eshban, Ithran, and Cheran.

verses.kjv: The sons of Ezer; Bilhan, and Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan; Uz, and Aran.
verses.decoded: The sons of Ezer were Bilhan, Zavan, and Jakan. The sons of Dishan were Uz and Aran.

verses.kjv: Now these are the kings that reigned in the land of Edom before any king reigned over the children of Israel; Bela the son of Beor: and the name of his city was Dinhabah.
verses.decoded: These are the kings who ruled in the land of Edom before any king ruled over the people of Israel: Bela, the son of Beor, and the name of his city was Dinhabah.

verses.kjv: And when Bela was dead, Jobab the son of Zerah of Bozrah reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: After Bela died, Jobab, the son of Zerah from Bozrah, became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And when Jobab was dead, Husham of the land of the Temanites reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: After Jobab died, Husham from the land of the Temanites became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And when Husham was dead, Hadad the son of Bedad, which smote Midian in the field of Moab, reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Avith.
verses.decoded: After Husham died, Hadad, the son of Bedad, who defeated Midian in the field of Moab, became king in his place. The name of his city was Avith.

verses.kjv: And when Hadad was dead, Samlah of Masrekah reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: After Hadad died, Samlah from Masrekah became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And when Samlah was dead, Shaul of Rehoboth by the river reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: After Samlah died, Shaul from Rehoboth by the river became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And when Shaul was dead, Baal-hanan the son of Achbor reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: After Shaul died, Baal-hanan, the son of Achbor, became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And when Baal-hanan was dead, Hadad reigned in his stead: and the name of his city was Pai; and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, the daughter of Mezahab.
verses.decoded: After Baal-hanan died, Hadad became king in his place. The name of his city was Pai, and his wife’s name was Mehetabel, the daughter of Matred, who was the daughter of Mezahab.

verses.kjv: Hadad died also. And the dukes of Edom were; duke Timnah, duke Aliah, duke Jetheth,
verses.decoded: Hadad also died. The leaders of Edom were: leader Timnah, leader Aliah, leader Jetheth,

verses.kjv: Duke Aholibamah, duke Elah, duke Pinon,
verses.decoded: Leader Aholibamah, leader Elah, leader Pinon,

verses.kjv: Duke Kenaz, duke Teman, duke Mibzar,
verses.decoded: Leader Kenaz, leader Teman, leader Mibzar,

verses.kjv: Duke Magdiel, duke Iram. These are the dukes of Edom.
verses.decoded: Leader Magdiel, leader Iram. These are the leaders of Edom.

verses.kjv: These are the sons of Israel; Reuben, Simeon, Levi, and Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun,
verses.decoded: These are the sons of Israel: Reuben, Simeon, Levi, Judah, Issachar, and Zebulun.

verses.kjv: Dan, Joseph, and Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.
verses.decoded: Dan, Joseph, Benjamin, Naphtali, Gad, and Asher.

verses.kjv: The sons of Judah; Er, and Onan, and Shelah: which three were born unto him of the daughter of Shua the Canaanitess. And Er, the firstborn of Judah, was evil in the sight of the Lord; and he slew him.
verses.decoded: The sons of Judah were Er, Onan, and Shelah; these three were born to him by the daughter of Shua the Canaanite woman. Er, the firstborn of Judah, was wicked in the eyes of the LORD, so the LORD put him to death.

verses.kjv: And Tamar his daughter in law bare him Pharez and Zerah. All the sons of Judah were five.
verses.decoded: And Tamar, his daughter-in-law, gave birth to Pharez and Zerah. Judah had five sons in total.

verses.kjv: The sons of Pharez; Hezron, and Hamul.
verses.decoded: The sons of Pharez were Hezron and Hamul.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Zerah; Zimri, and Ethan, and Heman, and Calcol, and Dara: five of them in all.
verses.decoded: The sons of Zerah were Zimri, Ethan, Heman, Calcol, and Dara: five in total.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Carmi; Achar, the troubler of Israel, who transgressed in the thing accursed.
verses.decoded: The sons of Carmi were Achar, the one who caused trouble for Israel by sinning in the matter that was under a curse.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Ethan; Azariah.
verses.decoded: The sons of Ethan were Azariah.

verses.kjv: The sons also of Hezron, that were born unto him; Jerahmeel, and Ram, and Chelubai.
verses.decoded: The sons of Hezron who were born to him were Jerahmeel, Ram, and Chelubai.

verses.kjv: And Ram begat Amminadab; and Amminadab begat Nahshon, prince of the children of Judah;
verses.decoded: Ram became the father of Amminadab; and Amminadab became the father of Nahshon, leader of the descendants of Judah;

verses.kjv: And Nahshon begat Salma, and Salma begat Boaz,
verses.decoded: Nahshon became the father of Salma, and Salma became the father of Boaz,

verses.kjv: And Boaz begat Obed, and Obed begat Jesse,
verses.decoded: Boaz became the father of Obed, and Obed became the father of Jesse,

verses.kjv: And Jesse begat his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,
verses.decoded: Jesse fathered his firstborn Eliab, and Abinadab the second, and Shimma the third,

verses.kjv: Nethaneel the fourth, Raddai the fifth,
verses.decoded: Nethaneel was the fourth, Raddai was the fifth,

verses.kjv: Ozem the sixth, David the seventh:
verses.decoded: Ozem was the sixth, and David was the seventh.

verses.kjv: Whose sisters were Zeruiah, and Abigail. And the sons of Zeruiah; Abishai, and Joab, and Asahel, three.
verses.decoded: Their sisters were Zeruiah and Abigail. The sons of Zeruiah were Abishai, Joab, and Asahel, three in total.

verses.kjv: And Abigail bare Amasa: and the father of Amasa was Jether the Ishmeelite.
verses.decoded: Abigail gave birth to Amasa, and Amasa's father was Jether the Ishmaelite.

verses.kjv: And Caleb the son of Hezron begat children of Azubah his wife, and of Jerioth: her sons are these; Jesher, and Shobab, and Ardon.
verses.decoded: Caleb, the son of Hezron, had children with Azubah, his wife, and with Jerioth. Her sons are these: Jesher, Shobab, and Ardon.

verses.kjv: And when Azubah was dead, Caleb took unto him Ephrath, which bare him Hur.
verses.decoded: After Azubah died, Caleb married Ephrath, who gave birth to Hur.

verses.kjv: And Hur begat Uri, and Uri begat Bezaleel.
verses.decoded: Hur became the father of Uri, and Uri became the father of Bezaleel.

verses.kjv: And afterward Hezron went in to the daughter of Machir the father of Gilead, whom he married when he was threescore years old; and she bare him Segub.
verses.decoded: After that, Hezron married the daughter of Machir, the father of Gilead, when he was sixty years old; and she gave birth to Segub.

verses.kjv: And Segub begat Jair, who had three and twenty cities in the land of Gilead.
verses.decoded: And Segub fathered Jair, who owned twenty-three cities in the land of Gilead.

verses.kjv: And he took Geshur, and Aram, with the towns of Jair, from them, with Kenath, and the towns thereof, even threescore cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir the father of Gilead.
verses.decoded: He took Geshur and Aram, along with the towns of Jair, from them, including Kenath and its towns, a total of sixty cities. All these belonged to the sons of Machir, the father of Gilead.

verses.kjv: And after that Hezron was dead in Caleb-ephratah, then Abiah Hezron’s wife bare him Ashur the father of Tekoa.
verses.decoded: After Hezron died in Caleb-ephratah, Abiah, Hezron’s wife, gave birth to Ashur, the father of Tekoa.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Jerahmeel the firstborn of Hezron were, Ram the firstborn, and Bunah, and Oren, and Ozem, and Ahijah.
verses.decoded: The sons of Jerahmeel, the firstborn of Hezron, were Ram the firstborn, Bunah, Oren, Ozem, and Ahijah.

verses.kjv: Jerahmeel had also another wife, whose name was Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.
verses.decoded: Jerahmeel also had another wife named Atarah; she was the mother of Onam.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Ram the firstborn of Jerahmeel were, Maaz, and Jamin, and Eker.
verses.decoded: The sons of Ram, the firstborn of Jerahmeel, were Maaz, Jamin, and Eker.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Onam were, Shammai, and Jada. And the sons of Shammai; Nadab, and Abishur.
verses.decoded: The sons of Onam were Shammai and Jada. The sons of Shammai were Nadab and Abishur.

verses.kjv: And the name of the wife of Abishur was Abihail, and she bare him Ahban, and Molid.
verses.decoded: The name of Abishur's wife was Abihail, and she gave birth to Ahban and Molid.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Nadab; Seled, and Appaim: but Seled died without children.
verses.decoded: The sons of Nadab were Seled and Appaim, but Seled died without having any children.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Appaim; Ishi. And the sons of Ishi; Sheshan. And the children of Sheshan; Ahlai.
verses.decoded: The sons of Appaim were Ishi. The sons of Ishi were Sheshan. The children of Sheshan were Ahlai.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Jada the brother of Shammai; Jether, and Jonathan: and Jether died without children.
verses.decoded: The sons of Jada, who was the brother of Shammai, were Jether and Jonathan; and Jether died without having children.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Jonathan; Peleth, and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.
verses.decoded: The sons of Jonathan were Peleth and Zaza. These were the sons of Jerahmeel.

verses.kjv: Now Sheshan had no sons, but daughters. And Sheshan had a servant, an Egyptian, whose name was Jarha.
verses.decoded: Sheshan did not have any sons, only daughters. Sheshan also had a servant who was an Egyptian, and his name was Jarha.

verses.kjv: And Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha his servant to wife; and she bare him Attai.
verses.decoded: Sheshan gave his daughter to Jarha, his servant, as a wife; and she gave birth to Attai.

verses.kjv: And Attai begat Nathan, and Nathan begat Zabad,
verses.decoded: Attai became the father of Nathan, and Nathan became the father of Zabad,

verses.kjv: And Zabad begat Ephlal, and Ephlal begat Obed,
verses.decoded: Zabad became the father of Ephlal, and Ephlal became the father of Obed,

verses.kjv: And Obed begat Jehu, and Jehu begat Azariah,
verses.decoded: Obed became the father of Jehu, and Jehu became the father of Azariah,

verses.kjv: And Azariah begat Helez, and Helez begat Eleasah,
verses.decoded: Azariah became the father of Helez, and Helez became the father of Eleasah,

verses.kjv: And Eleasah begat Sisamai, and Sisamai begat Shallum,
verses.decoded: Eleasah became the father of Sisamai, and Sisamai became the father of Shallum,

verses.kjv: And Shallum begat Jekamiah, and Jekamiah begat Elishama.
verses.decoded: Shallum became the father of Jekamiah, and Jekamiah became the father of Elishama.

verses.kjv: Now the sons of Caleb the brother of Jerahmeel were, Mesha his firstborn, which was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah the father of Hebron.
verses.decoded: The sons of Caleb, the brother of Jerahmeel, were Mesha, his firstborn, who was the father of Ziph; and the sons of Mareshah, the father of Hebron.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Hebron; Korah, and Tappuah, and Rekem, and Shema.
verses.decoded: The sons of Hebron were Korah, Tappuah, Rekem, and Shema.

verses.kjv: And Shema begat Raham, the father of Jorkoam: and Rekem begat Shammai.
verses.decoded: Shema became the father of Raham, who was the father of Jorkoam; and Rekem became the father of Shammai.

verses.kjv: And the son of Shammai was Maon: and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.
verses.decoded: Shammai's son was Maon, and Maon was the father of Beth-zur.

verses.kjv: And Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Haran, and Moza, and Gazez: and Haran begat Gazez.
verses.decoded: And Ephah, Caleb’s concubine, gave birth to Haran, Moza, and Gazez; and Haran fathered Gazez.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Jahdai; Regem, and Jotham, and Geshan, and Pelet, and Ephah, and Shaaph.
verses.decoded: The sons of Jahdai were Regem, Jotham, Gesham, Pelet, Ephah, and Shaaph.

verses.kjv: Maachah, Caleb’s concubine, bare Sheber, and Tirhanah.
verses.decoded: Maachah, Caleb’s concubine, gave birth to Sheber and Tirhanah.

verses.kjv: She bare also Shaaph the father of Madmannah, Sheva the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea: and the daughter of Caleb was Achsah.
verses.decoded: She also gave birth to Shaaph, the father of Madmannah, Sheva, the father of Machbenah, and the father of Gibea; and the daughter of Caleb was Achsa.

verses.kjv: These were the sons of Caleb the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah; Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim,
verses.decoded: These were the sons of Caleb, the son of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah: Shobal, the father of Kirjath-jearim,

verses.kjv: Salma the father of Beth-lehem, Hareph the father of Beth-gader.
verses.decoded: Salma was the father of Bethlehem, Hareph was the father of Beth-gader.

verses.kjv: And Shobal the father of Kirjath-jearim had sons; Haroeh, and half of the Manahethites.
verses.decoded: Shobal, the ancestor of Kirjath-jearim, had sons: Haroeh and half of the Manahethites.

verses.kjv: And the families of Kirjath-jearim; the Ithrites, and the Puhites, and the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; of them came the Zareathites, and the Eshtaulites.
verses.decoded: And the families from Kirjath-jearim: the Ithrites, the Puhites, the Shumathites, and the Mishraites; from them came the Zareathites and the Eshtaulites.

verses.kjv: The sons of Salma; Beth-lehem, and the Netophathites, Ataroth, the house of Joab, and half of the Manahethites, the Zorites.
verses.decoded: The descendants of Salma were Bethlehem, the Netophathites, Ataroth, the family of Joab, half of the Manahethites, and the Zorites.

verses.kjv: And the families of the scribes which dwelt at Jabez; the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and Suchathites. These are the Kenites that came of Hemath, the father of the house of Rechab.
verses.decoded: And the families of the scribes who lived in Jabez were the Tirathites, the Shimeathites, and the Suchathites. These are the Kenites who descended from Hemath, the ancestor of the house of Rechab.

verses.kjv: Now these were the sons of David, which were born unto him in Hebron; the firstborn Amnon, of Ahinoam the Jezreelitess; the second Daniel, of Abigail the Carmelitess:
verses.decoded: These were the sons of David who were born to him in Hebron: the firstborn Amnon, whose mother was Ahinoam from Jezreel; the second was Daniel, whose mother was Abigail from Carmel.

verses.kjv: The third, Absalom the son of Maachah the daughter of Talmai king of Geshur: the fourth, Adonijah the son of Haggith:
verses.decoded: The third was Absalom, the son of Maachah, the daughter of Talmai, king of Geshur; the fourth was Adonijah, the son of Haggith.

verses.kjv: The fifth, Shephatiah of Abital: the sixth, Ithream by Eglah his wife.
verses.decoded: The fifth was Shephatiah, whose mother was Abital; the sixth was Ithream, whose mother was Eglah, his wife.

verses.kjv: These six were born unto him in Hebron; and there he reigned seven years and six months: and in Jerusalem he reigned thirty and three years.
verses.decoded: These six were born to him in Hebron; and he ruled there for seven years and six months: and he ruled in Jerusalem for thirty-three years.

verses.kjv: And these were born unto him in Jerusalem; Shimea, and Shobab, and Nathan, and Solomon, four, of Bath-shua the daughter of Ammiel:
verses.decoded: These children were born to him in Jerusalem: Shimea, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon, four sons from Bath-shua, the daughter of Ammiel.

verses.kjv: Ibhar also, and Elishama, and Eliphelet,
verses.decoded: Ibhar, Elishama, and Eliphelet,

verses.kjv: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.decoded: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

verses.kjv: And Elishama, and Eliada, and Eliphelet, nine.
verses.decoded: Elishama, Eliada, and Eliphelet had nine sons.

verses.kjv: These were all the sons of David, beside the sons of the concubines, and Tamar their sister.
verses.decoded: These were all the sons of David, excluding the sons of the concubines, and their sister Tamar.

verses.kjv: And Solomon’s son was Rehoboam, Abia his son, Asa his son, Jehoshaphat his son,
verses.decoded: Solomon's son was Rehoboam, Rehoboam's son was Abia, Abia's son was Asa, Asa's son was Jehoshaphat,

verses.kjv: Joram his son, Ahaziah his son, Joash his son,
verses.decoded: Joram was his son, Ahaziah was his son, Joash was his son,

verses.kjv: Amaziah his son, Azariah his son, Jotham his son,
verses.decoded: Amaziah was his son, Azariah was his son, Jotham was his son,

verses.kjv: Ahaz his son, Hezekiah his son, Manasseh his son,
verses.decoded: Ahaz was his son, Hezekiah was his son, Manasseh was his son,

verses.kjv: Amon his son, Josiah his son.
verses.decoded: Amon was his son, and Josiah was his son.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Josiah were, the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, the fourth Shallum.
verses.decoded: The sons of Josiah were: the firstborn Johanan, the second Jehoiakim, the third Zedekiah, and the fourth Shallum.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Jehoiakim: Jeconiah his son, Zedekiah his son.
verses.decoded: The sons of Jehoiakim were Jeconiah his son and Zedekiah his son.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Jeconiah; Assir, Salathiel his son,
verses.decoded: The sons of Jeconiah were Assir and Salathiel his son.

verses.kjv: Malchiram also, and Pedaiah, and Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.
verses.decoded: Malchiram, Pedaiah, Shenazar, Jecamiah, Hoshama, and Nedabiah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Pedaiah were, Zerubbabel, and Shimei: and the sons of Zerubbabel; Meshullam, and Hananiah, and Shelomith their sister:
verses.decoded: The sons of Pedaiah were Zerubbabel and Shimei; and the children of Zerubbabel were Meshullam, Hananiah, and their sister Shelomith.

verses.kjv: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, Jushab-hesed, five.
verses.decoded: And Hashubah, and Ohel, and Berechiah, and Hasadiah, and Jushab-hesed, five.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Hananiah; Pelatiah, and Jesaiah: the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, the sons of Shechaniah.
verses.decoded: The sons of Hananiah were Pelatiah and Jesaiah; the sons of Rephaiah, the sons of Arnan, the sons of Obadiah, and the sons of Shechaniah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Shechaniah; Shemaiah: and the sons of Shemaiah; Hattush, and Igeal, and Bariah, and Neariah, and Shaphat, six.
verses.decoded: The sons of Shechaniah were Shemaiah; and the sons of Shemaiah were Hattush, Igeal, Bariah, Neariah, and Shaphat, six in total.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Neariah; Elioenai, and Hezekiah, and Azrikam, three.
verses.decoded: The sons of Neariah were Elioenai, Hezekiah, and Azrikam—three in total.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Elioenai were, Hodaiah, and Eliashib, and Pelaiah, and Akkub, and Johanan, and Dalaiah, and Anani, seven.
verses.decoded: The sons of Elioenai were Hodaiah, Eliashib, Pelaiah, Akkub, Johanan, Dalaiah, and Anani; there were seven in total.

verses.kjv: The sons of Judah; Pharez, Hezron, and Carmi, and Hur, and Shobal.
verses.decoded: The sons of Judah were Pharez, Hezron, Carmi, Hur, and Shobal.

verses.kjv: And Reaiah the son of Shobal begat Jahath; and Jahath begat Ahumai, and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.
verses.decoded: Reaiah, the son of Shobal, fathered Jahath; and Jahath fathered Ahumai and Lahad. These are the families of the Zorathites.

verses.kjv: And these were of the father of Etam; Jezreel, and Ishma, and Idbash: and the name of their sister was Hazelelponi:
verses.decoded: These were the children of the father of Etam: Jezreel, Ishma, and Idbash; and their sister's name was Hazelelponi.

verses.kjv: And Penuel the father of Gedor, and Ezer the father of Hushah. These are the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, the father of Beth-lehem.
verses.decoded: Penuel was the father of Gedor, and Ezer was the father of Hushah. These were the sons of Hur, the firstborn of Ephratah, who was the father of Bethlehem.

verses.kjv: And Ashur the father of Tekoa had two wives, Helah and Naarah.
verses.decoded: Ashur, the father of Tekoa, had two wives named Helah and Naarah.

verses.kjv: And Naarah bare him Ahuzam, and Hepher, and Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the sons of Naarah.
verses.decoded: And Naarah gave birth to Ahuzam, Hepher, Temeni, and Haahashtari. These were the children of Naarah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Helah were, Zereth, and Jezoar, and Ethnan.
verses.decoded: The sons of Helah were Zereth, Jezoar, and Ethnan.

verses.kjv: And Coz begat Anub, and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel the son of Harum.
verses.decoded: And Coz fathered Anub and Zobebah, and the families of Aharhel, the son of Harum.

verses.kjv: And Jabez was more honourable than his brethren: and his mother called his name Jabez, saying, Because I bare him with sorrow.
verses.decoded: And Jabez was more honorable than his brothers, and his mother named him Jabez, saying, Because I gave birth to him with pain.

verses.kjv: And Jabez called on the God of Israel, saying, Oh that thou wouldest bless me indeed, and enlarge my coast, and that thine hand might be with me, and that thou wouldest keep me from evil, that it may not grieve me! And God granted him that which he requested.
verses.decoded: And Jabez prayed to the God of Israel, saying, "Oh, that you would truly bless me, and expand my territory, and that your hand would be with me, and that you would keep me from harm so that I would not suffer!" And God granted him what he asked for.

verses.kjv: And Chelub the brother of Shuah begat Mehir, which was the father of Eshton.
verses.decoded: And Chelub, the brother of Shuah, fathered Mehir, who was the father of Eshton.

verses.kjv: And Eshton begat Beth-rapha, and Paseah, and Tehinnah the father of Ir-nahash. These are the men of Rechah.
verses.decoded: Eshton became the father of Beth-rapha, Paseah, and Tehinnah, who was the father of Ir-nahash. These are the people of Rechah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Kenaz; Othniel, and Seraiah: and the sons of Othniel; Hathath.
verses.decoded: The sons of Kenaz were Othniel and Seraiah; and the son of Othniel was Hathath.

verses.kjv: And Meonothai begat Ophrah: and Seraiah begat Joab, the father of the valley of Charashim; for they were craftsmen.
verses.decoded: Meonothai became the father of Ophrah, and Seraiah became the father of Joab, the leader of the valley of Charashim, because they were skilled workers.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Caleb the son of Jephunneh; Iru, Elah, and Naam: and the sons of Elah, even Kenaz.
verses.decoded: The sons of Caleb, the son of Jephunneh, were Iru, Elah, and Naam; and the sons of Elah included Kenaz.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Jehaleleel; Ziph, and Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.
verses.decoded: The sons of Jehaleleel were Ziph, Ziphah, Tiria, and Asareel.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Ezra were, Jether, and Mered, and Epher, and Jalon: and she bare Miriam, and Shammai, and Ishbah the father of Eshtemoa.
verses.decoded: The sons of Ezra were Jether, Mered, Epher, and Jalon; and she gave birth to Miriam, Shammai, and Ishbah, who was the father of Eshtemoa.

verses.kjv: And his wife Jehudijah bare Jered the father of Gedor, and Heber the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel the father of Zanoah. And these are the sons of Bithiah the daughter of Pharaoh, which Mered took.
verses.decoded: And his wife Jehudijah gave birth to Jered, the father of Gedor, and Heber, the father of Socho, and Jekuthiel, the father of Zanoah. These are the sons of Bithiah, the daughter of Pharaoh, whom Mered married.

verses.kjv: And the sons of his wife Hodiah the sister of Naham, the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.
verses.decoded: And the sons of his wife Hodiah, the sister of Naham, who was the father of Keilah the Garmite, and Eshtemoa the Maachathite.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Shimon were, Amnon, and Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. And the sons of Ishi were, Zoheth, and Ben-zoheth.
verses.decoded: The sons of Shimon were Amnon, Rinnah, Ben-hanan, and Tilon. The sons of Ishi were Zoheth and Ben-zoheth.

verses.kjv: The sons of Shelah the son of Judah were, Er the father of Lecah, and Laadah the father of Mareshah, and the families of the house of them that wrought fine linen, of the house of Ashbea,
verses.decoded: The sons of Shelah, the son of Judah, were Er, the father of Lecah, and Laadah, the father of Mareshah, and the families of the people who made fine linen, from the house of Ashbea.

verses.kjv: And Jokim, and the men of Chozeba, and Joash, and Saraph, who had the dominion in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. And these are ancient things.
verses.decoded: Jokim, the men of Chozeba, Joash, Saraph, who ruled in Moab, and Jashubi-lehem. These are old records.

verses.kjv: These were the potters, and those that dwelt among plants and hedges: there they dwelt with the king for his work.
verses.decoded: These were the potters, and those who lived among plants and hedges: there they lived with the king to do his work.

verses.kjv: The sons of Simeon were, Nemuel, and Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul:
verses.decoded: The sons of Simeon were Nemuel, Jamin, Jarib, Zerah, and Shaul.

verses.kjv: Shallum his son, Mibsam his son, Mishma his son.
verses.decoded: Shallum was his son, Mibsam was his son, Mishma was his son.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Mishma; Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, Shimei his son.
verses.decoded: The sons of Mishma were Hamuel his son, Zacchur his son, and Shimei his son.

verses.kjv: And Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brethren had not many children, neither did all their family multiply, like to the children of Judah.
verses.decoded: Shimei had sixteen sons and six daughters; but his brothers did not have many children, and their entire family did not grow as much as the children of Judah.

verses.kjv: And they dwelt at Beer-sheba, and Moladah, and Hazar-shual,
verses.decoded: And they lived in Beer-sheba, Moladah, and Hazar-shual,

verses.kjv: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,
verses.decoded: And at Bilhah, and at Ezem, and at Tolad,

verses.kjv: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,
verses.decoded: And at Bethuel, and at Hormah, and at Ziklag,

verses.kjv: And at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-birei, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities unto the reign of David.
verses.decoded: And at Beth-marcaboth, and Hazar-susim, and at Beth-birei, and at Shaaraim. These were their cities up to the time of King David.

verses.kjv: And their villages were, Etam, and Ain, Rimmon, and Tochen, and Ashan, five cities:
verses.decoded: Their villages were Etam, Ain, Rimmon, Tochen, and Ashan—five cities.

verses.kjv: And all their villages that were round about the same cities, unto Baal. These were their habitations, and their genealogy.
verses.decoded: And all their villages that were around those same cities, up to Baal. These were their places to live and their family records.

verses.kjv: And Meshobab, and Jamlech, and Joshah the son of Amaziah,
verses.decoded: Meshobab, Jamlech, and Joshah, the son of Amaziah,

verses.kjv: And Joel, and Jehu the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,
verses.decoded: And Joel, and Jehu, the son of Josibiah, the son of Seraiah, the son of Asiel,

verses.kjv: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,
verses.decoded: And Elioenai, and Jaakobah, and Jeshohaiah, and Asaiah, and Adiel, and Jesimiel, and Benaiah,

verses.kjv: And Ziza the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;
verses.decoded: And Ziza, the son of Shiphi, the son of Allon, the son of Jedaiah, the son of Shimri, the son of Shemaiah;

verses.kjv: These mentioned by their names were princes in their families: and the house of their fathers increased greatly.
verses.decoded: These people, named individually, were leaders in their families, and their family lines grew very large.

verses.kjv: And they went to the entrance of Gedor, even unto the east side of the valley, to seek pasture for their flocks.
verses.decoded: They went to the entrance of Gedor, to the east side of the valley, to look for pasture for their flocks.

verses.kjv: And they found fat pasture and good, and the land was wide, and quiet, and peaceable; for they of Ham had dwelt there of old.
verses.decoded: And they found rich and good pasture, and the land was spacious, peaceful, and calm; because the people of Ham had lived there long ago.

verses.kjv: And these written by name came in the days of Hezekiah king of Judah, and smote their tents, and the habitations that were found there, and destroyed them utterly unto this day, and dwelt in their rooms: because there was pasture there for their flocks.
verses.decoded: Those listed by name came during the time of Hezekiah, king of Judah, and attacked their tents and homes found there, completely destroying them up to this day, and lived in their places because there was grazing land for their flocks.

verses.kjv: And some of them, even of the sons of Simeon, five hundred men, went to mount Seir, having for their captains Pelatiah, and Neariah, and Rephaiah, and Uzziel, the sons of Ishi.
verses.decoded: Some of them, specifically five hundred men from the sons of Simeon, went to Mount Seir, led by their captains Pelatiah, Neariah, Rephaiah, and Uzziel, who were the sons of Ishi.

verses.kjv: And they smote the rest of the Amalekites that were escaped, and dwelt there unto this day.
verses.decoded: And they killed the remaining Amalekites who had escaped, and lived there up to this day.

verses.kjv: Now the sons of Reuben the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but, forasmuch as he defiled his father’s bed, his birthright was given unto the sons of Joseph the son of Israel: and the genealogy is not to be reckoned after the birthright.
verses.decoded: Now the sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, (for he was the firstborn; but because he defiled his father’s bed, his birthright was given to the sons of Joseph, the son of Israel; and the family record is not counted according to the birthright.

verses.kjv: For Judah prevailed above his brethren, and of him came the chief ruler; but the birthright was Joseph’s:)
verses.decoded: Because Judah was stronger than his brothers, and from him came the main leader; but the special inheritance belonged to Joseph.

verses.kjv: The sons, I say, of Reuben the firstborn of Israel were, Hanoch, and Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.
verses.decoded: The sons of Reuben, the firstborn of Israel, were Hanoch, Pallu, Hezron, and Carmi.

verses.kjv: The sons of Joel; Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, Shimei his son,
verses.decoded: The sons of Joel were Shemaiah his son, Gog his son, and Shimei his son.

verses.kjv: Micah his son, Reaia his son, Baal his son,
verses.decoded: Micah was his son, Reaia was his son, Baal was his son,

verses.kjv: Beerah his son, whom Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria carried away captive: he was prince of the Reubenites.
verses.decoded: Beerah, his son, whom Tiglath-Pileser king of Assyria took captive; he was the leader of the Reubenites.

verses.kjv: And his brethren by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was reckoned, were the chief, Jeiel, and Zechariah,
verses.decoded: And his brothers, by their families, when the genealogy of their generations was counted, were the leaders, Jeiel and Zechariah,

verses.kjv: And Bela the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, who dwelt in Aroer, even unto Nebo and Baal-meon:
verses.decoded: Bela, the son of Azaz, the son of Shema, the son of Joel, lived in Aroer, extending as far as Nebo and Baal-meon.

verses.kjv: And eastward he inhabited unto the entering in of the wilderness from the river Euphrates: because their cattle were multiplied in the land of Gilead.
verses.decoded: And he lived eastward up to the edge of the wilderness coming from the Euphrates River because their cattle increased in the land of Gilead.

verses.kjv: And in the days of Saul they made war with the Hagarites, who fell by their hand: and they dwelt in their tents throughout all the east land of Gilead.
verses.decoded: During the time of Saul, they fought against the Hagarites, who were defeated by them; and they lived in their tents throughout the entire eastern region of Gilead.

verses.kjv: And the children of Gad dwelt over against them, in the land of Bashan unto Salchah:
verses.decoded: The descendants of Gad lived opposite them, in the land of Bashan up to Salchah.

verses.kjv: Joel the chief, and Shapham the next, and Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.
verses.decoded: Joel was the leader, followed by Shapham, then Jaanai, and Shaphat in Bashan.

verses.kjv: And their brethren of the house of their fathers were, Michael, and Meshullam, and Sheba, and Jorai, and Jachan, and Zia, and Heber, seven.
verses.decoded: And their brothers from the family of their fathers were Michael, Meshullam, Sheba, Jorai, Jachan, Zia, and Heber, seven in total.

verses.kjv: These are the children of Abihail the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz;
verses.decoded: These are the descendants of Abihail, the son of Huri, the son of Jaroah, the son of Gilead, the son of Michael, the son of Jeshishai, the son of Jahdo, the son of Buz.

verses.kjv: Ahi the son of Abdiel, the son of Guni, chief of the house of their fathers.
verses.decoded: Ahi, the son of Abdiel, who was the son of Guni, was the leader of their family line.

verses.kjv: And they dwelt in Gilead in Bashan, and in her towns, and in all the suburbs of Sharon, upon their borders.
verses.decoded: They lived in Gilead in Bashan, and in its towns, and in all the surrounding areas of Sharon, along their borders.

verses.kjv: All these were reckoned by genealogies in the days of Jotham king of Judah, and in the days of Jeroboam king of Israel.
verses.decoded: All these were recorded in family records during the time of Jotham, king of Judah, and during the time of Jeroboam, king of Israel.

verses.kjv: The sons of Reuben, and the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, of valiant men, men able to bear buckler and sword, and to shoot with bow, and skilful in war, were four and forty thousand seven hundred and threescore, that went out to the war.
verses.decoded: The sons of Reuben, the Gadites, and half the tribe of Manasseh, who were brave men, able to carry shields and swords, to shoot with bows, and skilled in war, were 44,760 men who went out to battle.

verses.kjv: And they made war with the Hagarites, with Jetur, and Nephish, and Nodab.
verses.decoded: They fought against the Hagarites, along with Jetur, Nephish, and Nodab.

verses.kjv: And they were helped against them, and the Hagarites were delivered into their hand, and all that were with them: for they cried to God in the battle, and he was intreated of them; because they put their trust in him.
verses.decoded: They were helped against their enemies, and the Hagarites were handed over to them, along with everyone who was with them, because they cried out to God during the battle, and He listened to them, since they trusted in Him.

verses.kjv: And they took away their cattle; of their camels fifty thousand, and of sheep two hundred and fifty thousand, and of asses two thousand, and of men an hundred thousand.
verses.decoded: They took away their livestock: fifty thousand camels, two hundred fifty thousand sheep, two thousand donkeys, and one hundred thousand people.

verses.kjv: For there fell down many slain, because the war was of God. And they dwelt in their steads until the captivity.
verses.decoded: Many were killed because the battle was commanded by God. They lived in their own places until they were taken captive.

verses.kjv: And the children of the half tribe of Manasseh dwelt in the land: they increased from Bashan unto Baal-hermon and Senir, and unto mount Hermon.
verses.decoded: The descendants of the half tribe of Manasseh lived in the land; they multiplied from Bashan to Baal-hermon and Senir, and up to Mount Hermon.

verses.kjv: And these were the heads of the house of their fathers, even Epher, and Ishi, and Eliel, and Azriel, and Jeremiah, and Hodaviah, and Jahdiel, mighty men of valour, famous men, and heads of the house of their fathers.
verses.decoded: These were the leaders of their family houses: Epher, Ishi, Eliel, Azriel, Jeremiah, Hodaviah, and Jahdiel. They were brave warriors, well-known men, and leaders of their family houses.

verses.kjv: And they transgressed against the God of their fathers, and went a whoring after the gods of the people of the land, whom God destroyed before them.
verses.decoded: They sinned against the God of their ancestors and started worshiping the gods of the people living in the land, whom God had already destroyed before them.

verses.kjv: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser king of Assyria, and he carried them away, even the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them unto Halah, and Habor, and Hara, and to the river Gozan, unto this day.
verses.decoded: And the God of Israel stirred up the spirit of Pul, king of Assyria, and the spirit of Tilgath-pilneser, king of Assyria, and he took away the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, and brought them to Halah, Habor, Hara, and to the river Gozan, to this day.

verses.kjv: The sons of Levi; Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.decoded: The sons of Levi were Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.decoded: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.kjv: And the children of Amram; Aaron, and Moses, and Miriam. The sons also of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.decoded: The children of Amram were Aaron, Moses, and Miriam. The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.kjv: Eleazar begat Phinehas, Phinehas begat Abishua,
verses.decoded: Eleazar became the father of Phinehas, and Phinehas became the father of Abishua,

verses.kjv: And Abishua begat Bukki, and Bukki begat Uzzi,
verses.decoded: Abishua became the father of Bukki, and Bukki became the father of Uzzi,

verses.kjv: And Uzzi begat Zerahiah, and Zerahiah begat Meraioth,
verses.decoded: Uzzi became the father of Zerahiah, and Zerahiah became the father of Meraioth,

verses.kjv: Meraioth begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
verses.decoded: Meraioth fathered Amariah, and Amariah fathered Ahitub,

verses.kjv: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Ahimaaz,
verses.decoded: And Ahitub fathered Zadok, and Zadok fathered Ahimaaz,

verses.kjv: And Ahimaaz begat Azariah, and Azariah begat Johanan,
verses.decoded: And Ahimaaz fathered Azariah, and Azariah fathered Johanan,

verses.kjv: And Johanan begat Azariah, (he it is that executed the priest’s office in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem:)
verses.decoded: And Johanan fathered Azariah, who served as a priest in the temple that Solomon built in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And Azariah begat Amariah, and Amariah begat Ahitub,
verses.decoded: Azariah became the father of Amariah, and Amariah became the father of Ahitub,

verses.kjv: And Ahitub begat Zadok, and Zadok begat Shallum,
verses.decoded: And Ahitub became the father of Zadok, and Zadok became the father of Shallum,

verses.kjv: And Shallum begat Hilkiah, and Hilkiah begat Azariah,
verses.decoded: Shallum became the father of Hilkiah, and Hilkiah became the father of Azariah,

verses.kjv: And Azariah begat Seraiah, and Seraiah begat Jehozadak,
verses.decoded: Azariah fathered Seraiah, and Seraiah fathered Jehozadak,

verses.kjv: And Jehozadak went into captivity, when the Lord carried away Judah and Jerusalem by the hand of Nebuchadnezzar.
verses.decoded: Jehozadak was taken into captivity when the LORD allowed Judah and Jerusalem to be taken away by Nebuchadnezzar.

verses.kjv: The sons of Levi; Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.decoded: The sons of Levi were Gershom, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.kjv: And these be the names of the sons of Gershom; Libni, and Shimei.
verses.decoded: These are the names of the sons of Gershom: Libni and Shimei.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Kohath were, Amram, and Izhar, and Hebron, and Uzziel.
verses.decoded: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel.

verses.kjv: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. And these are the families of the Levites according to their fathers.
verses.decoded: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. These are the families of the Levites according to their ancestors.

verses.kjv: Of Gershom; Libni his son, Jahath his son, Zimmah his son,
verses.decoded: From Gershom: his son Libni, his son Jahath, his son Zimmah,

verses.kjv: Joah his son, Iddo his son, Zerah his son, Jeaterai his son.
verses.decoded: Joah was his son, Iddo was his son, Zerah was his son, Jeaterai was his son.

verses.kjv: The sons of Kohath; Amminadab his son, Korah his son, Assir his son,
verses.decoded: The sons of Kohath were Amminadab, his son; Korah, his son; Assir, his son.

verses.kjv: Elkanah his son, and Ebiasaph his son, and Assir his son,
verses.decoded: Elkanah was his son, Ebiasaph was his son, and Assir was his son,

verses.kjv: Tahath his son, Uriel his son, Uzziah his son, and Shaul his son.
verses.decoded: Tahath was his son, Uriel was his son, Uzziah was his son, and Shaul was his son.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Elkanah; Amasai, and Ahimoth.
verses.decoded: The sons of Elkanah were Amasai and Ahimoth.

verses.kjv: As for Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah; Zophai his son, and Nahath his son,
verses.decoded: Regarding Elkanah: the sons of Elkanah were Zophai his son and Nahath his son,

verses.kjv: Eliab his son, Jeroham his son, Elkanah his son.
verses.decoded: Eliab was his son, Jeroham was his son, Elkanah was his son.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Samuel; the firstborn Vashni, and Abiah.
verses.decoded: The sons of Samuel were the firstborn Vashni and Abiah.

verses.kjv: The sons of Merari; Mahli, Libni his son, Shimei his son, Uzza his son,
verses.decoded: The sons of Merari were Mahli, his son Libni, his son Shimei, and his son Uzza.

verses.kjv: Shimea his son, Haggiah his son, Asaiah his son.
verses.decoded: Shimea was his son, Haggiah was his son, Asaiah was his son.

verses.kjv: And these are they whom David set over the service of song in the house of the Lord, after that the ark had rest.
verses.decoded: These are the people whom David appointed to be in charge of the music ministry in the house of the LORD, after the ark was settled.

verses.kjv: And they ministered before the dwelling place of the tabernacle of the congregation with singing, until Solomon had built the house of the Lord in Jerusalem: and then they waited on their office according to their order.
verses.decoded: They served in front of the tent of meeting with singing until Solomon built the house of the LORD in Jerusalem; then they performed their duties according to their assigned order.

verses.kjv: And these are they that waited with their children. Of the sons of the Kohathites: Heman a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,
verses.decoded: These are the ones who served along with their children. From the sons of the Kohathites: Heman, a singer, the son of Joel, the son of Shemuel,

verses.kjv: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,
verses.decoded: The son of Elkanah, the son of Jeroham, the son of Eliel, the son of Toah,

verses.kjv: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,
verses.decoded: The son of Zuph, the son of Elkanah, the son of Mahath, the son of Amasai,

verses.kjv: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,
verses.decoded: The son of Elkanah, the son of Joel, the son of Azariah, the son of Zephaniah,

verses.kjv: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,
verses.decoded: The son of Tahath, the son of Assir, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah,

verses.kjv: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.
verses.decoded: The son of Izhar, the son of Kohath, the son of Levi, the son of Israel.

verses.kjv: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right hand, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,
verses.decoded: And his brother Asaph, who stood on his right side, even Asaph the son of Berachiah, the son of Shimea,

verses.kjv: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,
verses.decoded: The son of Michael, the son of Baaseiah, the son of Malchiah,

verses.kjv: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,
verses.decoded: The son of Ethni, the son of Zerah, the son of Adaiah,

verses.kjv: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,
verses.decoded: The son of Ethan, the son of Zimmah, the son of Shimei,

verses.kjv: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.
verses.decoded: The son of Jahath, the son of Gershom, the son of Levi.

verses.kjv: And their brethren the sons of Merari stood on the left hand: Ethan the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,
verses.decoded: And their relatives, the sons of Merari, stood on the left side: Ethan, the son of Kishi, the son of Abdi, the son of Malluch,

verses.kjv: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,
verses.decoded: The son of Hashabiah, the son of Amaziah, the son of Hilkiah,

verses.kjv: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,
verses.decoded: The son of Amzi, the son of Bani, the son of Shamer,

verses.kjv: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.
verses.decoded: The son of Mahli, the son of Mushi, the son of Merari, the son of Levi.

verses.kjv: Their brethren also the Levites were appointed unto all manner of service of the tabernacle of the house of God.
verses.decoded: Their brothers, the Levites, were also assigned to every kind of service in the tabernacle of the house of God.

verses.kjv: But Aaron and his sons offered upon the altar of the burnt offering, and on the altar of incense, and were appointed for all the work of the place most holy, and to make an atonement for Israel, according to all that Moses the servant of God had commanded.
verses.decoded: But Aaron and his sons offered sacrifices on the altar for burnt offerings and on the altar for incense, and they were assigned to do all the work in the most holy place, and to make atonement for Israel, following everything that Moses, the servant of God, had commanded.

verses.kjv: And these are the sons of Aaron; Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,
verses.decoded: These are the sons of Aaron: Eleazar his son, Phinehas his son, Abishua his son,

verses.kjv: Bukki his son, Uzzi his son, Zerahiah his son,
verses.decoded: Bukki was his son, Uzzi was his son, Zerahiah was his son,

verses.kjv: Meraioth his son, Amariah his son, Ahitub his son,
verses.decoded: Meraioth was his son, Amariah was his son, Ahitub was his son,

verses.kjv: Zadok his son, Ahimaaz his son.
verses.decoded: Zadok was his son, and Ahimaaz was his son.

verses.kjv: Now these are their dwelling places throughout their castles in their coasts, of the sons of Aaron, of the families of the Kohathites: for theirs was the lot.
verses.decoded: These are the places where the sons of Aaron, from the families of the Kohathites, lived throughout their fortified towns in their territories, because their portion was given to them.

verses.kjv: And they gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, and the suburbs thereof round about it.
verses.decoded: They gave them Hebron in the land of Judah, along with the surrounding suburbs.

verses.kjv: But the fields of the city, and the villages thereof, they gave to Caleb the son of Jephunneh.
verses.decoded: But they gave the fields of the city and its villages to Caleb, the son of Jephunneh.

verses.kjv: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, namely, Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with her suburbs, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their suburbs,
verses.decoded: And to the sons of Aaron they gave the cities of Judah, specifically Hebron, the city of refuge, and Libnah with its surrounding areas, and Jattir, and Eshtemoa, with their surrounding areas,

verses.kjv: And Hilen with her suburbs, Debir with her suburbs,
verses.decoded: And Hilen with its surrounding villages, Debir with its surrounding villages,

verses.kjv: And Ashan with her suburbs, and Beth-shemesh with her suburbs:
verses.decoded: And Ashan with its surrounding areas, and Beth-shemesh with its surrounding areas:

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Benjamin; Geba with her suburbs, and Alemeth with her suburbs, and Anathoth with her suburbs. All their cities throughout their families were thirteen cities.
verses.decoded: And from the tribe of Benjamin: Geba with its surrounding villages, and Alemeth with its surrounding villages, and Anathoth with its surrounding villages. All their cities throughout their clans were thirteen cities.

verses.kjv: And unto the sons of Kohath, which were left of the family of that tribe, were cities given out of the half tribe, namely, out of the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.
verses.decoded: And to the sons of Kohath, who remained from that family of the tribe, were given cities from the half tribe, specifically from the half tribe of Manasseh, by lot, ten cities.

verses.kjv: And to the sons of Gershom throughout their families out of the tribe of Issachar, and out of the tribe of Asher, and out of the tribe of Naphtali, and out of the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.
verses.decoded: And to the descendants of Gershom throughout their families, from the tribe of Issachar, from the tribe of Asher, from the tribe of Naphtali, and from the tribe of Manasseh in Bashan, thirteen cities.

verses.kjv: Unto the sons of Merari were given by lot, throughout their families, out of the tribe of Reuben, and out of the tribe of Gad, and out of the tribe of Zebulun, twelve cities.
verses.decoded: The sons of Merari were given twelve cities by lot, distributed among their families, from the tribe of Reuben, from the tribe of Gad, and from the tribe of Zebulun.

verses.kjv: And the children of Israel gave to the Levites these cities with their suburbs.
verses.decoded: The people of Israel gave these cities and their surrounding areas to the Levites.

verses.kjv: And they gave by lot out of the tribe of the children of Judah, and out of the tribe of the children of Simeon, and out of the tribe of the children of Benjamin, these cities, which are called by their names.
verses.decoded: They assigned these cities by casting lots from the tribe of the descendants of Judah, from the tribe of the descendants of Simeon, and from the tribe of the descendants of Benjamin; these cities are named as they are called.

verses.kjv: And the residue of the families of the sons of Kohath had cities of their coasts out of the tribe of Ephraim.
verses.decoded: The remaining families of the sons of Kohath had cities in the territory of the tribe of Ephraim.

verses.kjv: And they gave unto them, of the cities of refuge, Shechem in mount Ephraim with her suburbs; they gave also Gezer with her suburbs,
verses.decoded: They gave to them, from the cities of refuge, Shechem in the hill country of Ephraim with its surrounding towns; they also gave Gezer with its surrounding towns,

verses.kjv: And Jokmeam with her suburbs, and Beth-horon with her suburbs,
verses.decoded: And Jokmeam with its surrounding villages, and Beth-horon with its surrounding villages,

verses.kjv: And Aijalon with her suburbs, and Gath-rimmon with her suburbs:
verses.decoded: And Aijalon with its surrounding villages, and Gath-rimmon with its surrounding villages:

verses.kjv: And out of the half tribe of Manasseh; Aner with her suburbs, and Bileam with her suburbs, for the family of the remnant of the sons of Kohath.
verses.decoded: And from the half tribe of Manasseh: Aner with its surrounding towns, and Bileam with its surrounding towns, for the family of the remaining descendants of the sons of Kohath.

verses.kjv: Unto the sons of Gershom were given out of the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with her suburbs, and Ashtaroth with her suburbs:
verses.decoded: The sons of Gershom were given, from the family of the half tribe of Manasseh, Golan in Bashan with its surrounding villages, and Ashtaroth with its surrounding villages.

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Issachar; Kedesh with her suburbs, Daberath with her suburbs,
verses.decoded: And from the tribe of Issachar: Kedesh with its surrounding villages, Daberath with its surrounding villages,

verses.kjv: And Ramoth with her suburbs, and Anem with her suburbs:
verses.decoded: And Ramoth with its surrounding areas, and Anem with its surrounding areas:

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Asher; Mashal with her suburbs, and Abdon with her suburbs,
verses.decoded: And from the tribe of Asher: Mashal with its surrounding villages, and Abdon with its surrounding villages,

verses.kjv: And Hukok with her suburbs, and Rehob with her suburbs:
verses.decoded: And Hukok with its surrounding areas, and Rehob with its surrounding areas:

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Naphtali; Kedesh in Galilee with her suburbs, and Hammon with her suburbs, and Kirjathaim with her suburbs.
verses.decoded: And from the tribe of Naphtali: Kedesh in Galilee with its surrounding towns, and Hammon with its surrounding towns, and Kirjathaim with its surrounding towns.

verses.kjv: Unto the rest of the children of Merari were given out of the tribe of Zebulun, Rimmon with her suburbs, Tabor with her suburbs:
verses.decoded: To the remaining descendants of Merari, from the tribe of Zebulun, were given Rimmon with its surrounding villages, and Tabor with its surrounding villages.

verses.kjv: And on the other side Jordan by Jericho, on the east side of Jordan, were given them out of the tribe of Reuben, Bezer in the wilderness with her suburbs, and Jahzah with her suburbs,
verses.decoded: On the other side of the Jordan near Jericho, on the east side of the Jordan, were given to them from the tribe of Reuben: Bezer in the wilderness with its surrounding towns, and Jahzah with its surrounding towns,

verses.kjv: Kedemoth also with her suburbs, and Mephaath with her suburbs:
verses.decoded: Kedemoth along with its surrounding villages, and Mephaath along with its surrounding villages:

verses.kjv: And out of the tribe of Gad; Ramoth in Gilead with her suburbs, and Mahanaim with her suburbs,
verses.decoded: And from the tribe of Gad: Ramoth in Gilead with its surrounding towns, and Mahanaim with its surrounding towns,

verses.kjv: And Heshbon with her suburbs, and Jazer with her suburbs.
verses.decoded: And Heshbon with its surrounding areas, and Jazer with its surrounding areas.

verses.kjv: Now the sons of Issachar were, Tola, and Puah, Jashub, and Shimron, four.
verses.decoded: The sons of Issachar were Tola, Puah, Jashub, and Shimrom—four in total.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Tola; Uzzi, and Rephaiah, and Jeriel, and Jahmai, and Jibsam, and Shemuel, heads of their father’s house, to wit, of Tola: they were valiant men of might in their generations; whose number was in the days of David two and twenty thousand and six hundred.
verses.decoded: The sons of Tola were Uzzi, Rephaiah, Jeriel, Jahmai, Jibsam, and Shemuel. They were leaders of their family, the family of Tola. They were strong and brave men in their time. During the days of David, their number was twenty-two thousand six hundred.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Uzzi; Izrahiah: and the sons of Izrahiah; Michael, and Obadiah, and Joel, Ishiah, five: all of them chief men.
verses.decoded: The sons of Uzzi were Izrahiah; and the sons of Izrahiah were Michael, Obadiah, Joel, and Ishiah—five in total; all of them were leaders.

verses.kjv: And with them, by their generations, after the house of their fathers, were bands of soldiers for war, six and thirty thousand men: for they had many wives and sons.
verses.decoded: And with them, according to their families, following the house of their fathers, were groups of soldiers prepared for war, thirty-six thousand men: because they had many wives and sons.

verses.kjv: And their brethren among all the families of Issachar were valiant men of might, reckoned in all by their genealogies fourscore and seven thousand.
verses.decoded: And their brothers among all the families of Issachar were strong and brave men, totaling eighty-seven thousand according to their family records.

verses.kjv: The sons of Benjamin; Bela, and Becher, and Jediael, three.
verses.decoded: The sons of Benjamin were Bela, Becher, and Jediael, three in total.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Bela; Ezbon, and Uzzi, and Uzziel, and Jerimoth, and Iri, five; heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour; and were reckoned by their genealogies twenty and two thousand and thirty and four.
verses.decoded: The sons of Bela were Ezbon, Uzzi, Uzziel, Jerimoth, and Iri, five in total; they were leaders of their family houses, mighty warriors; and according to their genealogies, they were counted as twenty-two thousand, thirty-four.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Becher; Zemira, and Joash, and Eliezer, and Elioenai, and Omri, and Jerimoth, and Abiah, and Anathoth, and Alameth. All these are the sons of Becher.
verses.decoded: The sons of Becher were Zemira, Joash, Eliezer, Elioenai, Omri, Jerimoth, Abiah, Anathoth, and Alameth. All of these were the sons of Becher.

verses.kjv: And the number of them, after their genealogy by their generations, heads of the house of their fathers, mighty men of valour, was twenty thousand and two hundred.
verses.decoded: The total number of them, according to their family records by their generations, leaders of the family houses, brave warriors, was twenty thousand two hundred.

verses.kjv: The sons also of Jediael; Bilhan: and the sons of Bilhan; Jeush, and Benjamin, and Ehud, and Chenaanah, and Zethan, and Tharshish, and Ahishahar.
verses.decoded: The sons of Jediael were Bilhan; and the sons of Bilhan were Jeush, Benjamin, Ehud, Chenaanah, Zethan, Tharshish, and Ahishahar.

verses.kjv: All these the sons of Jediael, by the heads of their fathers, mighty men of valour, were seventeen thousand and two hundred soldiers, fit to go out for war and battle.
verses.decoded: All these were the sons of Jediael, counted by the leaders of their families, brave warriors, seventeen thousand two hundred soldiers, ready to go out to war and battle.

verses.kjv: Shuppim also, and Huppim, the children of Ir, and Hushim, the sons of Aher.
verses.decoded: Shuppim and Huppim were the children of Ir, and Hushim was the son of Aher.

verses.kjv: The sons of Naphtali; Jahziel, and Guni, and Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.
verses.decoded: The sons of Naphtali were Jahziel, Guni, Jezer, and Shallum, the sons of Bilhah.

verses.kjv: The sons of Manasseh; Ashriel, whom she bare: (but his concubine the Aramitess bare Machir the father of Gilead:
verses.decoded: The sons of Manasseh were Ashriel, whom she gave birth to; but his concubine, the Aramean woman, gave birth to Machir, the father of Gilead.

verses.kjv: And Machir took to wife the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose sister’s name was Maachah;) and the name of the second was Zelophehad: and Zelophehad had daughters.
verses.decoded: And Machir married the sister of Huppim and Shuppim, whose name was Maachah; and the name of the second was Zelophehad; and Zelophehad had daughters.

verses.kjv: And Maachah the wife of Machir bare a son, and she called his name Peresh; and the name of his brother was Sheresh; and his sons were Ulam and Rakem.
verses.decoded: Maachah, the wife of Machir, gave birth to a son, and she named him Peresh; his brother's name was Sheresh; and Sheresh's sons were Ulam and Rakem.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Ulam; Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, the son of Machir, the son of Manasseh.
verses.decoded: The sons of Ulam were Bedan. These were the sons of Gilead, who was the son of Machir, who was the son of Manasseh.

verses.kjv: And his sister Hammoleketh bare Ishod, and Abiezer, and Mahalah.
verses.decoded: And his sister Hammoleketh gave birth to Ishod, Abiezer, and Mahalah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Shemida were, Ahian, and Shechem, and Likhi, and Aniam.
verses.decoded: The sons of Shemidah were Ahian, Shechem, Likhi, and Aniam.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Ephraim; Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son,
verses.decoded: The sons of Ephraim were Shuthelah, and Bered his son, and Tahath his son, and Eladah his son, and Tahath his son.

verses.kjv: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath that were born in that land slew, because they came down to take away their cattle.
verses.decoded: And Zabad his son, and Shuthelah his son, and Ezer, and Elead, whom the men of Gath who were born in that land killed, because they came down to steal their cattle.

verses.kjv: And Ephraim their father mourned many days, and his brethren came to comfort him.
verses.decoded: Ephraim, their father, mourned for many days, and his brothers came to comfort him.

verses.kjv: And when he went in to his wife, she conceived, and bare a son, and he called his name Beriah, because it went evil with his house.
verses.decoded: When he had sexual relations with his wife, she became pregnant and gave birth to a son, and he named him Beriah because trouble came upon his family.

verses.kjv: (And his daughter was Sherah, who built Beth-horon the nether, and the upper, and Uzzen-sherah.)
verses.decoded: His daughter was Sherah, who built Lower Beth-horon, Upper Beth-horon, and Uzzen-sherah.

verses.kjv: And Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah his son, and Tahan his son,
verses.decoded: Rephah was his son, also Resheph, and Telah was his son, and Tahan was his son,

verses.kjv: Laadan his son, Ammihud his son, Elishama his son,
verses.decoded: Laadan was his son, Ammihud was his son, Elishama was his son,

verses.kjv: Non his son, Jehoshua his son.
verses.decoded: Non was his son, and Jehoshuah was his son.

verses.kjv: And their possessions and habitations were, Beth-el and the towns thereof, and eastward Naaran, and westward Gezer, with the towns thereof; Shechem also and the towns thereof, unto Gaza and the towns thereof:
verses.decoded: Their possessions and places where they lived were Bethel and its towns, Naaran to the east, Gezer and its towns to the west; also Shechem and its towns, extending to Gaza and its towns.

verses.kjv: And by the borders of the children of Manasseh, Beth-shean and her towns, Taanach and her towns, Megiddo and her towns, Dor and her towns. In these dwelt the children of Joseph the son of Israel.
verses.decoded: Along the borders of the descendants of Manasseh were Beth-shean and its towns, Taanach and its towns, Megiddo and its towns, Dor and its towns. The descendants of Joseph, the son of Israel, lived in these places.

verses.kjv: The sons of Asher; Imnah, and Isuah, and Ishuai, and Beriah, and Serah their sister.
verses.decoded: The sons of Asher were Imnah, Isuah, Ishuai, Beriah, and their sister Serah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Beriah; Heber, and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.
verses.decoded: The sons of Beriah were Heber and Malchiel, who is the father of Birzavith.

verses.kjv: And Heber begat Japhlet, and Shomer, and Hotham, and Shua their sister.
verses.decoded: Heber became the father of Japhlet, Shomer, Hotham, and their sister Shua.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Japhlet; Pasach, and Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.
verses.decoded: The sons of Japhlet were Pasach, Bimhal, and Ashvath. These are the children of Japhlet.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Shamer; Ahi, and Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.
verses.decoded: The sons of Shamer were Ahi, Rohgah, Jehubbah, and Aram.

verses.kjv: And the sons of his brother Helem; Zophah, and Imna, and Shelesh, and Amal.
verses.decoded: The sons of his brother Helem were Zophah, Imna, Shelesh, and Amal.

verses.kjv: The sons of Zophah; Suah, and Harnepher, and Shual, and Beri, and Imrah,
verses.decoded: The sons of Zophah were Suah, Harnepher, Shual, Beri, and Imrah.

verses.kjv: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.
verses.decoded: Bezer, and Hod, and Shamma, and Shilshah, and Ithran, and Beera.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Jether; Jephunneh, and Pispah, and Ara.
verses.decoded: The sons of Jether were Jephunneh, Pispah, and Ara.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Ulla; Arah, and Haniel, and Rezia.
verses.decoded: The sons of Ulla were Arah, Haniel, and Rezia.

verses.kjv: All these were the children of Asher, heads of their father’s house, choice and mighty men of valour, chief of the princes. And the number throughout the genealogy of them that were apt to the war and to battle was twenty and six thousand men.
verses.decoded: All these were the children of Asher, leaders of their father’s family, excellent and strong warriors, leaders of the princes. And the total number in their genealogy who were skilled for war and battle was twenty-six thousand men.

verses.kjv: Now Benjamin begat Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,
verses.decoded: Benjamin fathered Bela his firstborn, Ashbel the second, and Aharah the third,

verses.kjv: Nohah the fourth, and Rapha the fifth.
verses.decoded: Nohah was the fourth, and Rapha was the fifth.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Bela were, Addar, and Gera, and Abihud,
verses.decoded: The sons of Bela were Addar, Gera, and Abihud.

verses.kjv: And Abishua, and Naaman, and Ahoah,
verses.decoded: Abishua, Naaman, and Ahoah,

verses.kjv: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.
verses.decoded: And Gera, and Shephuphan, and Huram.

verses.kjv: And these are the sons of Ehud: these are the heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Geba, and they removed them to Manahath:
verses.decoded: These are the sons of Ehud: they were the leaders of the family heads of the people living in Geba, and they moved them to Manahath.

verses.kjv: And Naaman, and Ahiah, and Gera, he removed them, and begat Uzza, and Ahihud.
verses.decoded: Naaman, Ahiah, and Gera were taken away, and he fathered Uzza and Ahihud.

verses.kjv: And Shaharaim begat children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.
verses.decoded: And Shaharaim had children in the country of Moab, after he had sent them away; Hushim and Baara were his wives.

verses.kjv: And he begat of Hodesh his wife, Jobab, and Zibia, and Mesha, and Malcham,
verses.decoded: He fathered Jobab, Zibia, Mesha, and Malcham with Hodesh his wife.

verses.kjv: And Jeuz, and Shachia, and Mirma. These were his sons, heads of the fathers.
verses.decoded: Jeuz, Shachia, and Mirma were his sons, leaders of their families.

verses.kjv: And of Hushim he begat Abitub, and Elpaal.
verses.decoded: Hushim became the father of Abitub and Elpaal.

verses.kjv: The sons of Elpaal; Eber, and Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono, and Lod, with the towns thereof:
verses.decoded: The sons of Elpaal were Eber, Misham, and Shamed, who built Ono and Lod, along with the towns belonging to them.

verses.kjv: Beriah also, and Shema, who were heads of the fathers of the inhabitants of Aijalon, who drove away the inhabitants of Gath:
verses.decoded: Beriah and Shema were leaders of the family heads of the people living in Aijalon, who forced out the people living in Gath.

verses.kjv: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,
verses.decoded: And Ahio, Shashak, and Jeremoth,

verses.kjv: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,
verses.decoded: And Zebadiah, and Arad, and Ader,

verses.kjv: And Michael, and Ispah, and Joha, the sons of Beriah;
verses.decoded: Michael, Ispah, and Joha were the sons of Beriah.

verses.kjv: And Zebadiah, and Meshullam, and Hezeki, and Heber,
verses.decoded: Zebadiah, Meshullam, Hezeki, and Heber,

verses.kjv: Ishmerai also, and Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;
verses.decoded: Ishmerai, Jezliah, and Jobab, the sons of Elpaal;

verses.kjv: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,
verses.decoded: And Jakim, and Zichri, and Zabdi,

verses.kjv: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,
verses.decoded: And Elienai, and Zilthai, and Eliel,

verses.kjv: And Adaiah, and Beraiah, and Shimrath, the sons of Shimhi;
verses.decoded: Adaiah, Beraiah, and Shimrath were the sons of Shimhi.

verses.kjv: And Ishpan, and Heber, and Eliel,
verses.decoded: Ishpan, Heber, and Eliel,

verses.kjv: And Abdon, and Zichri, and Hanan,
verses.decoded: Abdon, Zichri, and Hanan,

verses.kjv: And Hananiah, and Elam, and Antothijah,
verses.decoded: Hananiah, Elam, and Antothijah,

verses.kjv: And Iphedeiah, and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;
verses.decoded: And Iphedeiah and Penuel, the sons of Shashak;

verses.kjv: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,
verses.decoded: And Shamsherai, and Shehariah, and Athaliah,

verses.kjv: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.
verses.decoded: And Jaresiah, and Eliah, and Zichri, the sons of Jeroham.

verses.kjv: These were heads of the fathers, by their generations, chief men. These dwelt in Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: These were leaders of their families, according to their generations, important men. They lived in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And at Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon; whose wife’s name was Maachah:
verses.decoded: And the father of Gibeon lived in Gibeon; his wife's name was Maachah:

verses.kjv: And his firstborn son Abdon, and Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,
verses.decoded: His firstborn son was Abdon, and then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Nadab,

verses.kjv: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.
verses.decoded: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zacher.

verses.kjv: And Mikloth begat Shimeah. And these also dwelt with their brethren in Jerusalem, over against them.
verses.decoded: Mikloth became the father of Shimeah. These people also lived with their brothers in Jerusalem, opposite them.

verses.kjv: And Ner begat Kish, and Kish begat Saul, and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
verses.decoded: Ner fathered Kish, and Kish fathered Saul, and Saul fathered Jonathan, Malchi-shua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.

verses.kjv: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal; and Merib-baal begat Micah.
verses.decoded: Jonathan's son was Merib-baal, and Merib-baal was the father of Micah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tarea, and Ahaz.
verses.decoded: The sons of Micah were Pithon, Melech, Tarea, and Ahaz.

verses.kjv: And Ahaz begat Jehoadah; and Jehoadah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza,
verses.decoded: Ahaz became the father of Jehoadah; Jehoadah became the father of Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri became the father of Moza,

verses.kjv: And Moza begat Binea: Rapha was his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son:
verses.decoded: Moza became the father of Binea. Binea became the father of Rapha. Rapha became the father of Eleasah. Eleasah became the father of Azel.

verses.kjv: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan. All these were the sons of Azel.
verses.decoded: Azel had six sons, and their names were Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan. All of these were the sons of Azel.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Eshek his brother were, Ulam his firstborn, Jehush the second, and Eliphelet the third.
verses.decoded: The sons of Eshek, his brother, were Ulam, his oldest son, Jehush, the second son, and Eliphelet, the third son.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Ulam were mighty men of valour, archers, and had many sons, and sons’ sons, an hundred and fifty. All these are of the sons of Benjamin.
verses.decoded: The sons of Ulam were brave warriors, skilled archers, and they had many sons and grandsons, totaling one hundred and fifty. All of these were from the tribe of Benjamin.

verses.kjv: So all Israel were reckoned by genealogies; and, behold, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were carried away to Babylon for their transgression.
verses.decoded: So all Israel was recorded by family histories; and look, they were written in the book of the kings of Israel and Judah, who were taken to Babylon because of their sin.

verses.kjv: Now the first inhabitants that dwelt in their possessions in their cities were, the Israelites, the priests, Levites, and the Nethinims.
