verses.decoded: The original residents living in their own property within their cities were the Israelites, the priests, the Levites, and the Nethinims.

verses.kjv: And in Jerusalem dwelt of the children of Judah, and of the children of Benjamin, and of the children of Ephraim, and Manasseh;
verses.decoded: And in Jerusalem lived some of the descendants of Judah, and some of the descendants of Benjamin, and some of the descendants of Ephraim, and Manasseh;

verses.kjv: Uthai the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, of the children of Pharez the son of Judah.
verses.decoded: Uthai, the son of Ammihud, the son of Omri, the son of Imri, the son of Bani, from the descendants of Pharez, the son of Judah.

verses.kjv: And of the Shilonites; Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.
verses.decoded: And from the Shilonites: Asaiah the firstborn, and his sons.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Zerah; Jeuel, and their brethren, six hundred and ninety.
verses.decoded: And from the sons of Zerah: Jeuel and their brothers, six hundred and ninety.

verses.kjv: And of the sons of Benjamin; Sallu the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,
verses.decoded: And from the descendants of Benjamin: Sallu, the son of Meshullam, the son of Hodaviah, the son of Hasenuah,

verses.kjv: And Ibneiah the son of Jeroham, and Elah the son of Uzzi, the son of Michri, and Meshullam the son of Shephathiah, the son of Reuel, the son of Ibnijah;
verses.decoded: Ibneiah, the son of Jeroham; Elah, the son of Uzzi, who was the son of Michri; and Meshullam, the son of Shephatiah, who was the son of Reuel, who was the son of Ibnijah;

verses.kjv: And their brethren, according to their generations, nine hundred and fifty and six. All these men were chief of the fathers in the house of their fathers.
verses.decoded: And their brothers, according to their family lines, were nine hundred and fifty-six. All these men were leaders of the family groups in the house of their ancestors.

verses.kjv: And of the priests; Jedaiah, and Jehoiarib, and Jachin,
verses.decoded: And among the priests were Jedaiah, Jehoiarib, and Jachin,

verses.kjv: And Azariah the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, the ruler of the house of God;
verses.decoded: Azariah, the son of Hilkiah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Zadok, the son of Meraioth, the son of Ahitub, was the leader of the house of God.

verses.kjv: And Adaiah the son of Jeroham, the son of Pashur, the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai the son of Adiel, the son of Jahzerah, the son of Meshullam, the son of Meshillemith, the son of Immer;
verses.decoded: And Adaiah, the son of Jeroham, who was the son of Pashur, who was the son of Malchijah, and Maasiai, the son of Adiel, who was the son of Jahzerah, who was the son of Meshullam, who was the son of Meshillemith, who was the son of Immer;

verses.kjv: And their brethren, heads of the house of their fathers, a thousand and seven hundred and threescore; very able men for the work of the service of the house of God.
verses.decoded: And their brothers, leaders of their family houses, one thousand seven hundred and sixty; very capable men for the work of serving in the house of God.

verses.kjv: And of the Levites; Shemaiah the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, of the sons of Merari;
verses.decoded: And among the Levites: Shemaiah, the son of Hasshub, the son of Azrikam, the son of Hashabiah, from the descendants of Merari;

verses.kjv: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;
verses.decoded: And Bakbakkar, Heresh, and Galal, and Mattaniah, the son of Micah, the son of Zichri, the son of Asaph;

verses.kjv: And Obadiah the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, that dwelt in the villages of the Netophathites.
verses.decoded: Obadiah, the son of Shemaiah, the son of Galal, the son of Jeduthun, and Berechiah, the son of Asa, the son of Elkanah, lived in the villages of the Netophathites.

verses.kjv: And the porters were, Shallum, and Akkub, and Talmon, and Ahiman, and their brethren: Shallum was the chief;
verses.decoded: The gatekeepers were Shallum, Akkub, Talmon, Ahiman, and their relatives; Shallum was the leader.

verses.kjv: Who hitherto waited in the king’s gate eastward: they were porters in the companies of the children of Levi.
verses.decoded: Who up to this time waited at the king’s gate on the east side: they were gatekeepers in the groups of the descendants of Levi.

verses.kjv: And Shallum the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brethren, of the house of his father, the Korahites, were over the work of the service, keepers of the gates of the tabernacle: and their fathers, being over the host of the Lord, were keepers of the entry.
verses.decoded: Shallum, the son of Kore, the son of Ebiasaph, the son of Korah, and his brothers, from their father's family, the Korahites, were in charge of the work of the service, guarding the gates of the tabernacle. Their ancestors, who were in charge of the LORD's army, guarded the entrance.

verses.kjv: And Phinehas the son of Eleazar was the ruler over them in time past, and the Lord was with him.
verses.decoded: Phinehas, the son of Eleazar, was their leader in the past, and the Lord was with him.

verses.kjv: And Zechariah the son of Meshelemiah was porter of the door of the tabernacle of the congregation.
verses.decoded: And Zechariah, the son of Meshelemiah, was the gatekeeper of the door of the tabernacle of the assembly.

verses.kjv: All these which were chosen to be porters in the gates were two hundred and twelve. These were reckoned by their genealogy in their villages, whom David and Samuel the seer did ordain in their set office.
verses.decoded: All those who were chosen to be gatekeepers were two hundred and twelve. They were recorded by their family records in their villages, and David and Samuel the prophet appointed them to their assigned duties.

verses.kjv: So they and their children had the oversight of the gates of the house of the Lord, namely, the house of the tabernacle, by wards.
verses.decoded: So they and their children were responsible for watching over the gates of the house of the Lord, that is, the house of the tabernacle, in shifts.

verses.kjv: In four quarters were the porters, toward the east, west, north, and south.
verses.decoded: The gatekeepers were stationed in four directions: east, west, north, and south.

verses.kjv: And their brethren, which were in their villages, were to come after seven days from time to time with them.
verses.decoded: And their brothers, who were in their villages, were to come after seven days, regularly, with them.

verses.kjv: For these Levites, the four chief porters, were in their set office, and were over the chambers and treasuries of the house of God.
verses.decoded: These Levites, the four main gatekeepers, were in their assigned positions and were in charge of the rooms and storage areas of the house of God.

verses.kjv: And they lodged round about the house of God, because the charge was upon them, and the opening thereof every morning pertained to them.
verses.decoded: They stayed all around the house of God because they were responsible for it, and opening it every morning was their duty.

verses.kjv: And certain of them had the charge of the ministering vessels, that they should bring them in and out by tale.
verses.decoded: And some of them were responsible for the service vessels, making sure they were brought in and taken out by count.

verses.kjv: Some of them also were appointed to oversee the vessels, and all the instruments of the sanctuary, and the fine flour, and the wine, and the oil, and the frankincense, and the spices.
verses.decoded: Some of them were also assigned to take care of the vessels, all the tools of the sanctuary, the fine flour, the wine, the oil, the frankincense, and the spices.

verses.kjv: And some of the sons of the priests made the ointment of the spices.
verses.decoded: Some of the priests' sons made the ointment from the spices.

verses.kjv: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, had the set office over the things that were made in the pans.
verses.decoded: And Mattithiah, one of the Levites, who was the firstborn of Shallum the Korahite, was assigned the specific duty over the items prepared in the pans.

verses.kjv: And other of their brethren, of the sons of the Kohathites, were over the shewbread, to prepare it every sabbath.
verses.decoded: Other members of their relatives, from the sons of the Kohathites, were responsible for the showbread, to prepare it every Sabbath.

verses.kjv: And these are the singers, chief of the fathers of the Levites, who remaining in the chambers were free: for they were employed in that work day and night.
verses.decoded: These are the singers, leaders of the families of the Levites, who stayed in the rooms and were free because they worked at that task day and night.

verses.kjv: These chief fathers of the Levites were chief throughout their generations; these dwelt at Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: These leading ancestors of the Levites were leaders throughout their generations; they lived in Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And in Gibeon dwelt the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife’s name was Maachah:
verses.decoded: And in Gibeon lived the father of Gibeon, Jehiel, whose wife's name was Maachah:

verses.kjv: And his firstborn son Abdon, then Zur, and Kish, and Baal, and Ner, and Nadab,
verses.decoded: His firstborn son was Abdon, then Zur, Kish, Baal, Ner, and Nadab,

verses.kjv: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.
verses.decoded: And Gedor, and Ahio, and Zechariah, and Mikloth.

verses.kjv: And Mikloth begat Shimeam. And they also dwelt with their brethren at Jerusalem, over against their brethren.
verses.decoded: Mikloth became the father of Shimeam. They also lived with their relatives in Jerusalem, across from their relatives.

verses.kjv: And Ner begat Kish; and Kish begat Saul; and Saul begat Jonathan, and Malchi-shua, and Abinadab, and Esh-baal.
verses.decoded: Ner fathered Kish; Kish fathered Saul; and Saul fathered Jonathan, Malchi-shua, Abinadab, and Esh-baal.

verses.kjv: And the son of Jonathan was Merib-baal: and Merib-baal begat Micah.
verses.decoded: Jonathan's son was Merib-baal, and Merib-baal became the father of Micah.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Micah were, Pithon, and Melech, and Tahrea, and Ahaz.
verses.decoded: The sons of Micah were Pithon, Melech, Tahrea, and Ahaz.

verses.kjv: And Ahaz begat Jarah; and Jarah begat Alemeth, and Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri begat Moza;
verses.decoded: Ahaz fathered Jarah; Jarah fathered Alemeth, Azmaveth, and Zimri; and Zimri fathered Moza.

verses.kjv: And Moza begat Binea; and Rephaiah his son, Eleasah his son, Azel his son.
verses.decoded: Moza became the father of Binea; Binea became the father of Rephaiah, Rephaiah became the father of Eleasah, and Eleasah became the father of Azel.

verses.kjv: And Azel had six sons, whose names are these, Azrikam, Bocheru, and Ishmael, and Sheariah, and Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.
verses.decoded: Azel had six sons, and their names were Azrikam, Bocheru, Ishmael, Sheariah, Obadiah, and Hanan: these were the sons of Azel.

verses.kjv: Now the Philistines fought against Israel; and the men of Israel fled from before the Philistines, and fell down slain in mount Gilboa.
verses.decoded: The Philistines fought against Israel, and the men of Israel ran away from the Philistines and were killed on Mount Gilboa.

verses.kjv: And the Philistines followed hard after Saul, and after his sons; and the Philistines slew Jonathan, and Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.
verses.decoded: The Philistines chased closely after Saul and his sons; the Philistines killed Jonathan, Abinadab, and Malchi-shua, the sons of Saul.

verses.kjv: And the battle went sore against Saul, and the archers hit him, and he was wounded of the archers.
verses.decoded: The battle turned badly against Saul, and the archers shot him, and he was wounded by the archers.

verses.kjv: Then said Saul to his armourbearer, Draw thy sword, and thrust me through therewith; lest these uncircumcised come and abuse me. But his armourbearer would not; for he was sore afraid. So Saul took a sword, and fell upon it.
verses.decoded: Then Saul said to his armor-bearer, "Draw your sword and kill me with it; otherwise these uncircumcised enemies will come and mistreat me." But his armor-bearer refused because he was very afraid. So Saul took a sword and fell on it.

verses.kjv: And when his armourbearer saw that Saul was dead, he fell likewise on the sword, and died.
verses.decoded: And when his armor bearer saw that Saul was dead, he also fell on the sword and died.

verses.kjv: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his house died together.
verses.decoded: So Saul died, and his three sons, and all his family died together.

verses.kjv: And when all the men of Israel that were in the valley saw that they fled, and that Saul and his sons were dead, then they forsook their cities, and fled: and the Philistines came and dwelt in them.
verses.decoded: When all the men of Israel who were in the valley saw that they were running away and that Saul and his sons were dead, they abandoned their cities and fled; then the Philistines came and lived in those cities.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass on the morrow, when the Philistines came to strip the slain, that they found Saul and his sons fallen in mount Gilboa.
verses.decoded: The next day, when the Philistines came to take the bodies of the dead, they found Saul and his sons lying dead on Mount Gilboa.

verses.kjv: And when they had stripped him, they took his head, and his armour, and sent into the land of the Philistines round about, to carry tidings unto their idols, and to the people.
verses.decoded: After they had taken his clothes, they took his head and his armor and sent them throughout the land of the Philistines to announce the news to their idols and to the people.

verses.kjv: And they put his armour in the house of their gods, and fastened his head in the temple of Dagon.
verses.decoded: They placed his armor in the temple of their gods and hung his head in the temple of Dagon.

verses.kjv: And when all Jabesh-gilead heard all that the Philistines had done to Saul,
verses.decoded: When all the people of Jabesh-gilead heard everything the Philistines had done to Saul,

verses.kjv: They arose, all the valiant men, and took away the body of Saul, and the bodies of his sons, and brought them to Jabesh, and buried their bones under the oak in Jabesh, and fasted seven days.
verses.decoded: All the brave men got up, took the body of Saul and the bodies of his sons, brought them to Jabesh, buried their bones under the oak tree in Jabesh, and fasted for seven days.

verses.kjv: So Saul died for his transgression which he committed against the Lord, even against the word of the Lord, which he kept not, and also for asking counsel of one that had a familiar spirit, to inquire of it;
verses.decoded: So Saul died because of the sin he committed against the LORD, specifically for not obeying the LORD's command, and also for seeking advice from a person who had a spirit medium, to ask questions.

verses.kjv: And inquired not of the Lord: therefore he slew him, and turned the kingdom unto David the son of Jesse.
verses.decoded: And he did not ask the LORD; therefore, he killed him and gave the kingdom to David, the son of Jesse.

verses.kjv: Then all Israel gathered themselves to David unto Hebron, saying, Behold, we are thy bone and thy flesh.
verses.decoded: Then all Israel came together to David at Hebron, saying, Look, we are your own people.

verses.kjv: And moreover in time past, even when Saul was king, thou wast he that leddest out and broughtest in Israel: and the Lord thy God said unto thee, Thou shalt feed my people Israel, and thou shalt be ruler over my people Israel.
verses.decoded: And also in the past, even when Saul was king, you were the one who led Israel out and brought them in: and the LORD your God said to you, You will shepherd my people Israel, and you will be ruler over my people Israel, and you will be ruler over my people Israel.

verses.kjv: Therefore came all the elders of Israel to the king to Hebron; and David made a covenant with them in Hebron before the Lord; and they anointed David king over Israel, according to the word of the Lord by Samuel.
verses.decoded: So all the leaders of Israel came to the king at Hebron, and David made an agreement with them at Hebron in the presence of the LORD. They anointed David as king over Israel, following the LORD's command given through Samuel.

verses.kjv: And David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is Jebus; where the Jebusites were, the inhabitants of the land.
verses.decoded: David and all Israel went to Jerusalem, which is also called Jebus; the Jebusites, who lived in the land, were there.

verses.kjv: And the inhabitants of Jebus said to David, Thou shalt not come hither. Nevertheless David took the castle of Zion, which is the city of David.
verses.decoded: And the people living in Jebus said to David, You will not come here. However, David captured the fortress of Zion, which is the city of David.

verses.kjv: And David said, Whosoever smiteth the Jebusites first shall be chief and captain. So Joab the son of Zeruiah went first up, and was chief.
verses.decoded: And David said, Whoever strikes the Jebusites first will be the leader and commander. So Joab, the son of Zeruiah, went up first and became the leader.

verses.kjv: And David dwelt in the castle; therefore they called it the city of David.
verses.decoded: David lived in the fortress; so they named it the city of David.

verses.kjv: And he built the city round about, even from Millo round about: and Joab repaired the rest of the city.
verses.decoded: He built the city all around, starting from Millo all around, and Joab repaired the rest of the city.

verses.kjv: So David waxed greater and greater: for the Lord of hosts was with him.
verses.decoded: So David became more and more powerful because the LORD of hosts was with him.

verses.kjv: These also are the chief of the mighty men whom David had, who strengthened themselves with him in his kingdom, and with all Israel, to make him king, according to the word of the Lord concerning Israel.
verses.decoded: These are also the leaders of the mighty warriors who supported David in his kingdom, along with all Israel, to make him king, following the word of the LORD about Israel.

verses.kjv: And this is the number of the mighty men whom David had; Jashobeam, an Hachmonite, the chief of the captains: he lifted up his spear against three hundred slain by him at one time.
verses.decoded: These are the number of the mighty men David had: Jashobeam, a Hachmonite, the leader of the captains; he raised his spear and killed three hundred men at one time.

verses.kjv: And after him was Eleazar the son of Dodo, the Ahohite, who was one of the three mighties.
verses.decoded: After him was Eleazar, the son of Dodo, from Ahoah, who was one of the three mighty warriors.

verses.kjv: He was with David at Pas-dammim, and there the Philistines were gathered together to battle, where was a parcel of ground full of barley; and the people fled from before the Philistines.
verses.decoded: He was with David at Pas-dammim, and there the Philistines had gathered to fight, where there was a field full of barley; and the people ran away from the Philistines.

verses.kjv: And they set themselves in the midst of that parcel, and delivered it, and slew the Philistines; and the Lord saved them by a great deliverance.
verses.decoded: They positioned themselves in the middle of that group, rescued it, and killed the Philistines; and the LORD saved them with a great rescue.

verses.kjv: Now three of the thirty captains went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the host of the Philistines encamped in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.decoded: Now three of the thirty commanders went down to the rock to David, into the cave of Adullam; and the army of the Philistines camped in the valley of Rephaim.

verses.kjv: And David was then in the hold, and the Philistines’ garrison was then at Beth-lehem.
verses.decoded: At that time, David was in the fortress, and the Philistine army was stationed at Bethlehem.

verses.kjv: And David longed, and said, Oh that one would give me drink of the water of the well of Beth-lehem, that is at the gate!
verses.decoded: And David was very thirsty and said, I wish someone would give me a drink of the water from the well of Bethlehem, which is by the city gate!

verses.kjv: And the three brake through the host of the Philistines, and drew water out of the well of Beth-lehem, that was by the gate, and took it, and brought it to David: but David would not drink of it, but poured it out to the Lord,
verses.decoded: And the three men broke through the army of the Philistines, drew water from the well of Bethlehem, which was by the gate, took it, and brought it to David; but David would not drink it, instead he poured it out as an offering to the LORD,

verses.kjv: And said, My God forbid it me, that I should do this thing: shall I drink the blood of these men that have put their lives in jeopardy? for with the jeopardy of their lives they brought it. Therefore he would not drink it. These things did these three mightiest.
verses.decoded: And he said, 'God forbid that I should do this thing: should I drink the blood of these men who risked their lives? Because they risked their lives to get it.' Therefore, he refused to drink it. These things were done by these three mighty men.

verses.kjv: And Abishai the brother of Joab, he was chief of the three: for lifting up his spear against three hundred, he slew them, and had a name among the three.
verses.decoded: Abishai, the brother of Joab, was the leader of the three warriors because he raised his spear against three hundred men, killed them, and became famous among the three.

verses.kjv: Of the three, he was more honourable than the two; for he was their captain: howbeit he attained not to the first three.
verses.decoded: Among the three, he was more honorable than the other two because he was their leader; however, he did not reach the top three.

verses.kjv: Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, the son of a valiant man of Kabzeel, who had done many acts; he slew two lionlike men of Moab: also he went down and slew a lion in a pit in a snowy day.
verses.decoded: Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, the son of a brave man from Kabzeel, who had done many great deeds; he killed two strong men from Moab who were like lions: he also went down into a pit and killed a lion on a snowy day.

verses.kjv: And he slew an Egyptian, a man of great stature, five cubits high; and in the Egyptian’s hand was a spear like a weaver’s beam; and he went down to him with a staff, and plucked the spear out of the Egyptian’s hand, and slew him with his own spear.
verses.decoded: He killed an Egyptian, a very tall man, about seven and a half feet tall; the Egyptian held a spear as large as a weaver’s beam. He approached him with a staff, took the spear from the Egyptian’s hand, and killed him with his own spear.

verses.kjv: These things did Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, and had the name among the three mighties.
verses.decoded: Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, did these things and was known as one of the three mighty warriors.

verses.kjv: Behold, he was honourable among the thirty, but attained not to the first three: and David set him over his guard.
verses.decoded: Look, he was respected among the thirty, but did not reach the top three; and David put him in charge of his bodyguard.

verses.kjv: Also the valiant men of the armies were, Asahel the brother of Joab, Elhanan the son of Dodo of Beth-lehem,
verses.decoded: Also the brave warriors of the armies were Asahel, the brother of Joab, and Elhanan, the son of Dodo from Bethlehem,

verses.kjv: Shammoth the Harorite, Helez the Pelonite,
verses.decoded: Shammoth from Haror, Helez from Pelon,

verses.kjv: Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite, Abi-ezer the Antothite,
verses.decoded: Ira, the son of Ikkesh from Tekoa, Abi-ezer from Antoth,

verses.kjv: Sibbecai the Hushathite, Ilai the Ahohite,
verses.decoded: Sibbecai from Hushah, Ilai from Ahoh,

verses.kjv: Maharai the Netophathite, Heled the son of Baanah the Netophathite,
verses.decoded: Maharai from Netophah, Heled, the son of Baanah from Netophah,

verses.kjv: Ithai the son of Ribai of Gibeah, that pertained to the children of Benjamin, Benaiah the Pirathonite,
verses.decoded: Ithai, the son of Ribai from Gibeah, who belonged to the tribe of Benjamin, Benaiah from Pirathon,

verses.kjv: Hurai of the brooks of Gaash, Abiel the Arbathite,
verses.decoded: Hurai from the streams of Gaash, Abiel from Arbath.

verses.kjv: Azmaveth the Baharumite, Eliahba the Shaalbonite,
verses.decoded: Azmaveth from Baharum, Eliahba from Shaalbon,

verses.kjv: The sons of Hashem the Gizonite, Jonathan the son of Shage the Hararite,
verses.decoded: The sons of Hashem from Gizon, Jonathan the son of Shage from Harar,

verses.kjv: Ahiam the son of Sacar the Hararite, Eliphal the son of Ur,
verses.decoded: Ahiam, the son of Sacar from Harar, Eliphal, the son of Ur,

verses.kjv: Hepher the Mecherathite, Ahijah the Pelonite,
verses.decoded: Hepher from Mecherath, Ahijah from Pelonite,

verses.kjv: Hezro the Carmelite, Naarai the son of Ezbai,
verses.decoded: Hezro from Carmel, Naarai, the son of Ezbai,

verses.kjv: Joel the brother of Nathan, Mibhar the son of Haggeri,
verses.decoded: Joel, the brother of Nathan, and Mibhar, the son of Haggeri,

verses.kjv: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armourbearer of Joab the son of Zeruiah,
verses.decoded: Zelek the Ammonite, Naharai the Berothite, the armor-bearer of Joab, the son of Zeruiah,

verses.kjv: Ira the Ithrite, Gareb the Ithrite,
verses.decoded: Ira from Ithra, Gareb from Ithra,

verses.kjv: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,
verses.decoded: Uriah the Hittite, Zabad the son of Ahlai,

verses.kjv: Adina the son of Shiza the Reubenite, a captain of the Reubenites, and thirty with him,
verses.decoded: Adina, the son of Shiza, a Reubenite and a leader of the Reubenites, along with thirty men with him,

verses.kjv: Hanan the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat the Mithnite,
verses.decoded: Hanan, the son of Maachah, and Joshaphat from Mithnite,

verses.kjv: Uzzia the Ashterathite, Shama and Jehiel the sons of Hothan the Aroerite,
verses.decoded: Uzzia from Ashterath, Shama and Jehiel, the sons of Hothan from Aroer.

verses.kjv: Jediael the son of Shimri, and Joha his brother, the Tizite,
verses.decoded: Jediael, the son of Shimri, and Joha, his brother, who was from Tizit,

verses.kjv: Eliel the Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah the Moabite,
verses.decoded: Eliel from Mahavite, and Jeribai, and Joshaviah, the sons of Elnaam, and Ithmah from Moab,

verses.kjv: Eliel, and Obed, and Jasiel the Mesobaite.
verses.decoded: Eliel, Obed, and Jasiel from Mesoba.

verses.kjv: Now these are they that came to David to Ziklag, while he yet kept himself close because of Saul the son of Kish: and they were among the mighty men, helpers of the war.
verses.decoded: These are the men who came to David at Ziklag while he was still hiding because of Saul, the son of Kish; they were among the strong warriors, supporters in battle.

verses.kjv: They were armed with bows, and could use both the right hand and the left in hurling stones and shooting arrows out of a bow, even of Saul’s brethren of Benjamin.
verses.decoded: They were equipped with bows and could use both their right and left hands to throw stones and shoot arrows from a bow, including Saul’s relatives from the tribe of Benjamin.

verses.kjv: The chief was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah the Gibeathite; and Jeziel, and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah, and Jehu the Antothite,
verses.decoded: The leader was Ahiezer, then Joash, the sons of Shemaah from Gibeah; and Jeziel and Pelet, the sons of Azmaveth; and Berachah and Jehu from Antoth,

verses.kjv: And Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a mighty man among the thirty, and over the thirty; and Jeremiah, and Jahaziel, and Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,
verses.decoded: Ismaiah the Gibeonite, a strong man among the thirty and leader of the thirty; also Jeremiah, Jahaziel, Johanan, and Josabad the Gederathite,

verses.kjv: Eluzai, and Jerimoth, and Bealiah, and Shemariah, and Shephatiah the Haruphite,
verses.decoded: Eluzai, Jerimoth, Bealiah, Shemariah, and Shephatiah, the Haruphite,

verses.kjv: Elkanah, and Jesiah, and Azareel, and Joezer, and Jashobeam, the Korhites,
verses.decoded: Elkanah, Jesiah, Azareel, Joezer, and Jashobeam, who were Korhites,

verses.kjv: And Joelah, and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham of Gedor.
verses.decoded: And Joelah and Zebadiah, the sons of Jeroham from Gedor.

verses.kjv: And of the Gadites there separated themselves unto David into the hold to the wilderness men of might, and men of war fit for the battle, that could handle shield and buckler, whose faces were like the faces of lions, and were as swift as the roes upon the mountains;
verses.decoded: And from the Gadites, strong and brave warriors separated themselves to join David in the fortress in the wilderness. They were men prepared for battle, skilled in using shields and small shields, with faces like lions, and as fast as deer on the mountains.

verses.kjv: Ezer the first, Obadiah the second, Eliab the third,
verses.decoded: Ezer was first, Obadiah was second, Eliab was third,

verses.kjv: Mishmannah the fourth, Jeremiah the fifth,
verses.decoded: Mishmannah was the fourth, Jeremiah was the fifth,

verses.kjv: Attai the sixth, Eliel the seventh,
verses.decoded: Attai was the sixth, Eliel was the seventh,

verses.kjv: Johanan the eighth, Elzabad the ninth,
verses.decoded: Johanan was the eighth, Elzabad was the ninth,

verses.kjv: Jeremiah the tenth, Machbanai the eleventh.
verses.decoded: Jeremiah was the tenth, Machbanai was the eleventh.

verses.kjv: These were of the sons of Gad, captains of the host: one of the least was over an hundred, and the greatest over a thousand.
verses.decoded: These were from the sons of Gad, leaders of the army: the smallest commanded over one hundred, and the greatest commanded over a thousand.

verses.kjv: These are they that went over Jordan in the first month, when it had overflown all his banks; and they put to flight all them of the valleys, both toward the east, and toward the west.
verses.decoded: These are the ones who crossed the Jordan River in the first month, when it had overflowed all its banks; and they chased away all the people in the valleys, both to the east and to the west.

verses.kjv: And there came of the children of Benjamin and Judah to the hold unto David.
verses.decoded: Some of the people from the tribes of Benjamin and Judah came to the fortress to join David.

verses.kjv: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said unto them, If ye be come peaceably unto me to help me, mine heart shall be knit unto you: but if ye be come to betray me to mine enemies, seeing there is no wrong in mine hands, the God of our fathers look thereon, and rebuke it.
verses.decoded: And David went out to meet them, and answered and said to them, If you have come peacefully to me to help me, my heart will be united with you; but if you have come to betray me to my enemies, since there is no wrong in my hands, may the God of our ancestors see it and punish it.

verses.kjv: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was chief of the captains, and he said, Thine are we, David, and on thy side, thou son of Jesse: peace, peace be unto thee, and peace be to thine helpers; for thy God helpeth thee. Then David received them, and made them captains of the band.
verses.decoded: Then the spirit came upon Amasai, who was the leader of the captains, and he said, We belong to you, David, and we are on your side, you son of Jesse: peace, peace be with you, and peace be with your supporters; because your God is helping you. Then David accepted them and made them leaders of the group.

verses.kjv: And there fell some of Manasseh to David, when he came with the Philistines against Saul to battle: but they helped them not: for the lords of the Philistines upon advisement sent him away, saying, He will fall to his master Saul to the jeopardy of our heads.
verses.decoded: Some men from Manasseh joined David when he came with the Philistines to fight against Saul, but they did not help them because the leaders of the Philistines, after discussing it, sent David away, saying, 'He will turn against his master Saul and put us in danger.'

verses.kjv: As he went to Ziklag, there fell to him of Manasseh, Adnah, and Jozabad, and Jediael, and Michael, and Jozabad, and Elihu, and Zilthai, captains of the thousands that were of Manasseh.
verses.decoded: As he went to Ziklag, the leaders of the thousands from Manasseh joined him: Adnah, Jozabad, Jediael, Michael, Jozabad, Elihu, and Zilthai.

verses.kjv: And they helped David against the band of the rovers: for they were all mighty men of valour, and were captains in the host.
verses.decoded: And they helped David against the group of raiders because they were all strong and brave men, and they were leaders in the army.

verses.kjv: For at that time day by day there came to David to help him, until it was a great host, like the host of God.
verses.decoded: Because at that time, day after day, people came to David to help him, until he had a large army, like the army of God.

verses.kjv: And these are the numbers of the bands that were ready armed to the war, and came to David to Hebron, to turn the kingdom of Saul to him, according to the word of the Lord.
verses.decoded: These are the numbers of the groups that were fully armed for battle and came to David at Hebron to transfer Saul's kingdom to him, as the LORD had said.

verses.kjv: The children of Judah that bare shield and spear were six thousand and eight hundred, ready armed to the war.
verses.decoded: The people of Judah who carried shields and spears were six thousand eight hundred, fully prepared for battle.

verses.kjv: Of the children of Simeon, mighty men of valour for the war, seven thousand and one hundred.
verses.decoded: From the descendants of Simeon, there were seven thousand one hundred brave warriors ready for battle.

verses.kjv: Of the children of Levi four thousand and six hundred.
verses.decoded: There were four thousand six hundred descendants of Levi.

verses.kjv: And Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and with him were three thousand and seven hundred;
verses.decoded: Jehoiada was the leader of the Aaronites, and three thousand seven hundred men were with him.

verses.kjv: And Zadok, a young man mighty of valour, and of his father’s house twenty and two captains.
verses.decoded: And Zadok, a young man strong and brave, and twenty-two captains from his father's family.

verses.kjv: And of the children of Benjamin, the kindred of Saul, three thousand: for hitherto the greatest part of them had kept the ward of the house of Saul.
verses.decoded: And from the tribe of Benjamin, Saul's relatives, there were three thousand, because until now most of them had guarded the house of Saul.

verses.kjv: And of the children of Ephraim twenty thousand and eight hundred, mighty men of valour, famous throughout the house of their fathers.
verses.decoded: And from the descendants of Ephraim, twenty thousand eight hundred strong and courageous men, well-known throughout their family lineage.

verses.kjv: And of the half tribe of Manasseh eighteen thousand, which were expressed by name, to come and make David king.
verses.decoded: And from the half tribe of Manasseh, eighteen thousand men, whose names were recorded, came to make David king.

verses.kjv: And of the children of Issachar, which were men that had understanding of the times, to know what Israel ought to do; the heads of them were two hundred; and all their brethren were at their commandment.
verses.decoded: From the descendants of Issachar, there were men who understood the current situation and knew what Israel should do; their leaders were two hundred, and all their relatives followed their instructions.

verses.kjv: Of Zebulun, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, with all instruments of war, fifty thousand, which could keep rank: they were not of double heart.
verses.decoded: From Zebulun, those who went out to battle were skilled in war, equipped with all kinds of weapons, fifty thousand men who could maintain their formation; they were not divided in loyalty.

verses.kjv: And of Naphtali a thousand captains, and with them with shield and spear thirty and seven thousand.
verses.decoded: And from Naphtali, one thousand commanders, and with them thirty-seven thousand with shields and spears.

verses.kjv: And of the Danites expert in war twenty and eight thousand and six hundred.
verses.decoded: And among the Danites, there were twenty-eight thousand six hundred men skilled in war.

verses.kjv: And of Asher, such as went forth to battle, expert in war, forty thousand.
verses.decoded: And from Asher, those who went out to battle, skilled in war, were forty thousand.

verses.kjv: And on the other side of Jordan, of the Reubenites, and the Gadites, and of the half tribe of Manasseh, with all manner of instruments of war for the battle, an hundred and twenty thousand.
verses.decoded: And on the other side of the Jordan River, from the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, there were one hundred and twenty thousand men equipped with all kinds of weapons for battle.

verses.kjv: All these men of war, that could keep rank, came with a perfect heart to Hebron, to make David king over all Israel: and all the rest also of Israel were of one heart to make David king.
verses.decoded: All these soldiers, who could keep their formation, came with sincere hearts to Hebron to make David king over all Israel; and all the rest of Israel were united in their desire to make David king.

verses.kjv: And there they were with David three days, eating and drinking: for their brethren had prepared for them.
verses.decoded: And they stayed with David for three days, eating and drinking, because their brothers had prepared food for them.

verses.kjv: Moreover they that were nigh them, even unto Issachar and Zebulun and Naphtali, brought bread on asses, and on camels, and on mules, and on oxen, and meat, meal, cakes of figs, and bunches of raisins, and wine, and oil, and oxen, and sheep abundantly: for there was joy in Israel.
verses.decoded: Also, those who were near them, including the people of Issachar, Zebulun, and Naphtali, brought bread on donkeys, camels, mules, and oxen, as well as meat, grain, fig cakes, bunches of raisins, wine, oil, oxen, and sheep in great abundance, because there was joy in Israel.

verses.kjv: And David consulted with the captains of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.
verses.decoded: David talked with the commanders of thousands and hundreds, and with every leader.

verses.kjv: And David said unto all the congregation of Israel, If it seem good unto you, and that it be of the Lord our God, let us send abroad unto our brethren every where, that are left in all the land of Israel, and with them also to the priests and Levites which are in their cities and suburbs, that they may gather themselves unto us:
verses.decoded: And David said to all the assembly of Israel, If it seems good to you, and if it is from the LORD our God, let us send messengers to our relatives everywhere who remain in all the land of Israel, and also to the priests and Levites who are in their cities and surrounding areas, so that they may gather together with us.

verses.kjv: And let us bring again the ark of our God to us: for we inquired not at it in the days of Saul.
verses.decoded: Let us bring back the ark of our God to us, because we did not ask for guidance about it during the days of Saul.

verses.kjv: And all the congregation said that they would do so: for the thing was right in the eyes of all the people.
verses.decoded: And all the assembly said that they would do it because it was right in the eyes of all the people.

verses.kjv: So David gathered all Israel together, from Shihor of Egypt even unto the entering of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath-jearim.
verses.decoded: So David gathered all of Israel together, from Shihor near Egypt up to the entrance of Hemath, to bring the ark of God from Kirjath-jearim.

verses.kjv: And David went up, and all Israel, to Baalah, that is, to Kirjath-jearim, which belonged to Judah, to bring up thence the ark of God the Lord, that dwelleth between the cherubims, whose name is called on it.
verses.decoded: David went up, along with all Israel, to Baalah, which is Kirjath-jearim, a town that belonged to Judah, to bring up from there the ark of God, the LORD, who lives between the cherubim, and whose name is called on the ark.

verses.kjv: And they carried the ark of God in a new cart out of the house of Abinadab: and Uzza and Ahio drave the cart.
verses.decoded: They transported the ark of God on a new cart from the house of Abinadab, and Uzza and Ahio were driving the cart.

verses.kjv: And David and all Israel played before God with all their might, and with singing, and with harps, and with psalteries, and with timbrels, and with cymbals, and with trumpets.
verses.decoded: And David and all Israel performed before God with all their strength, singing and playing harps, psalteries, timbrels, cymbals, and trumpets.

verses.kjv: And when they came unto the threshingfloor of Chidon, Uzza put forth his hand to hold the ark; for the oxen stumbled.
verses.decoded: When they reached the threshing floor of Chidon, Uzza reached out his hand to steady the ark because the oxen stumbled.

verses.kjv: And the anger of the Lord was kindled against Uzza, and he smote him, because he put his hand to the ark: and there he died before God.
verses.decoded: The LORD became angry with Uzza, and he struck him down because Uzza touched the ark; he died there in the presence of God.

verses.kjv: And David was displeased, because the Lord had made a breach upon Uzza: wherefore that place is called Perez-uzza to this day.
verses.decoded: And David was upset because the LORD struck Uzza down; therefore, that place is called Perez-uzza to this day.

verses.kjv: And David was afraid of God that day, saying, How shall I bring the ark of God home to me?
verses.decoded: And David was afraid of God that day and said, How can I bring the ark of God to my house?

verses.kjv: So David brought not the ark home to himself to the city of David, but carried it aside into the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.
verses.decoded: So David did not bring the ark to his own home in the city of David, but instead took it to the house of Obed-edom the Gittite.

verses.kjv: And the ark of God remained with the family of Obed-edom in his house three months. And the Lord blessed the house of Obed-edom, and all that he had.
verses.decoded: The ark of God stayed with the family of Obed-edom in his house for three months. The LORD blessed the house of Obed-edom and everything he owned.

verses.kjv: Now Hiram king of Tyre sent messengers to David, and timber of cedars, with masons and carpenters, to build him an house.
verses.decoded: Now Hiram, king of Tyre, sent messengers to David, along with cedar wood, masons, and carpenters to build a house for him.

verses.kjv: And David perceived that the Lord had confirmed him king over Israel, for his kingdom was lifted up on high, because of his people Israel.
verses.decoded: David realized that the LORD had established him as king over Israel because his kingdom was exalted due to his people Israel.

verses.kjv: And David took more wives at Jerusalem: and David begat more sons and daughters.
verses.decoded: And David married more wives in Jerusalem, and David had more sons and daughters.

verses.kjv: Now these are the names of his children which he had in Jerusalem; Shammua, and Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon,
verses.decoded: These are the names of his children whom he had in Jerusalem: Shammua, Shobab, Nathan, and Solomon.

verses.kjv: And Ibhar, and Elishua, and Elpalet,
verses.decoded: And Ibhar, Elishua, and Elpalet,

verses.kjv: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,
verses.decoded: And Nogah, and Nepheg, and Japhia,

verses.kjv: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.
verses.decoded: And Elishama, and Beeliada, and Eliphalet.

verses.kjv: And when the Philistines heard that David was anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to seek David. And David heard of it, and went out against them.
verses.decoded: When the Philistines heard that David had been anointed king over all Israel, all the Philistines went up to fight against David. David heard about it and went out to meet them.

verses.kjv: And the Philistines came and spread themselves in the valley of Rephaim.
verses.decoded: The Philistines came and positioned themselves throughout the valley of Rephaim.

verses.kjv: And David inquired of God, saying, Shall I go up against the Philistines? and wilt thou deliver them into mine hand? And the Lord said unto him, Go up; for I will deliver them into thine hand.
verses.decoded: And David asked God, saying, Should I go up against the Philistines? Will you deliver them into my hand? And the LORD said to him, Go up; for I will deliver them into your hand.

verses.kjv: So they came up to Baal-perazim; and David smote them there. Then David said, God hath broken in upon mine enemies by mine hand like the breaking forth of waters: therefore they called the name of that place Baal-perazim.
verses.decoded: So they came up to Baal-perazim, and David defeated them there. Then David said, God has broken through my enemies by my hand like a rushing flood; so they named that place Baal-perazim.

verses.kjv: And when they had left their gods there, David gave a commandment, and they were burned with fire.
verses.decoded: After they left their gods there, David gave an order, and they were burned with fire.

verses.kjv: And the Philistines yet again spread themselves abroad in the valley.
verses.decoded: The Philistines once again spread out across the valley.

verses.kjv: Therefore David inquired again of God; and God said unto him, Go not up after them; turn away from them, and come upon them over against the mulberry trees.
verses.decoded: Therefore David asked God again; and God said to him, Do not go up after them; turn away from them, and come against them near the mulberry trees.

verses.kjv: And it shall be, when thou shalt hear a sound of going in the tops of the mulberry trees, that then thou shalt go out to battle: for God is gone forth before thee to smite the host of the Philistines.
verses.decoded: And it will happen, when you hear the sound of movement in the tops of the mulberry trees, then you should go out to battle, because God has gone ahead of you to defeat the army of the Philistines.

verses.kjv: David therefore did as God commanded him: and they smote the host of the Philistines from Gibeon even to Gazer.
verses.decoded: David did exactly what God commanded him, and they defeated the army of the Philistines from Gibeon all the way to Gazer.

verses.kjv: And the fame of David went out into all lands; and the Lord brought the fear of him upon all nations.
verses.decoded: David's reputation spread throughout all the lands, and the LORD caused all nations to fear him.

verses.kjv: And David made him houses in the city of David, and prepared a place for the ark of God, and pitched for it a tent.
verses.decoded: David built houses for himself in the city of David, prepared a place for the ark of God, and set up a tent for it.

verses.kjv: Then David said, None ought to carry the ark of God but the Levites: for them hath the Lord chosen to carry the ark of God, and to minister unto him for ever.
verses.decoded: Then David said, No one should carry the ark of God except the Levites, because the LORD has chosen them to carry the ark of God and to serve him forever.

verses.kjv: And David gathered all Israel together to Jerusalem, to bring up the ark of the Lord unto his place, which he had prepared for it.
verses.decoded: David gathered all of Israel together in Jerusalem to bring the ark of the LORD to the place he had prepared for it.

verses.kjv: And David assembled the children of Aaron, and the Levites:
verses.decoded: David gathered the descendants of Aaron and the Levites.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Kohath; Uriel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twenty:
verses.decoded: From the sons of Kohath: Uriel was the leader, and with him were one hundred and twenty of his relatives.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Merari; Asaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred and twenty:
verses.decoded: From the descendants of Merari: Asaiah was the leader, and with him were his brothers, two hundred and twenty in total.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Gershom; Joel the chief, and his brethren an hundred and thirty:
verses.decoded: From the sons of Gershom: Joel was the leader, and his brothers were one hundred and thirty.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Elizaphan; Shemaiah the chief, and his brethren two hundred:
verses.decoded: From the sons of Elizaphan: Shemaiah was the leader, and with him were two hundred of his brothers.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Hebron; Eliel the chief, and his brethren fourscore:
verses.decoded: From the sons of Hebron: Eliel was the leader, and his brothers were eighty.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Uzziel; Amminadab the chief, and his brethren an hundred and twelve.
verses.decoded: From the sons of Uzziel: Amminadab was the leader, and his brothers were one hundred and twelve.

verses.kjv: And David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, and Joel, Shemaiah, and Eliel, and Amminadab,
verses.decoded: David called for Zadok and Abiathar the priests, and for the Levites, for Uriel, Asaiah, Joel, Shemaiah, Eliel, and Amminadab,

verses.kjv: And said unto them, Ye are the chief of the fathers of the Levites: sanctify yourselves, both ye and your brethren, that ye may bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel unto the place that I have prepared for it.
verses.decoded: And said to them, You are the leaders of the families of the Levites: make yourselves holy, both you and your brothers, so that you may carry the ark of the LORD God of Israel to the place I have prepared for it.

verses.kjv: For because ye did it not at the first, the Lord our God made a breach upon us, for that we sought him not after the due order.
verses.decoded: Because you did not do it at first, the LORD our God caused a failure for us, because we did not seek him in the proper way.

verses.kjv: So the priests and the Levites sanctified themselves to bring up the ark of the Lord God of Israel.
verses.decoded: So the priests and the Levites made themselves holy to carry up the ark of the Lord God of Israel.

verses.kjv: And the children of the Levites bare the ark of God upon their shoulders with the staves thereon, as Moses commanded according to the word of the Lord.
verses.decoded: The Levite descendants carried the ark of God on their shoulders using the poles attached to it, just as Moses commanded according to the word of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And David spake to the chief of the Levites to appoint their brethren to be the singers with instruments of musick, psalteries and harps and cymbals, sounding, by lifting up the voice with joy.
verses.decoded: And David spoke to the leaders of the Levites to appoint their fellow Levites as singers with musical instruments, psalteries, harps, and cymbals, making music by raising their voices with joy.

verses.kjv: So the Levites appointed Heman the son of Joel; and of his brethren, Asaph the son of Berechiah; and of the sons of Merari their brethren, Ethan the son of Kushaiah;
verses.decoded: So the Levites appointed Heman, the son of Joel; and among his brothers, Asaph, the son of Berechiah; and among the sons of Merari, their brothers, Ethan, the son of Kushaiah;

verses.kjv: And with them their brethren of the second degree, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the porters.
verses.decoded: And with them their relatives of the second rank, Zechariah, Ben, and Jaaziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, Eliab, and Benaiah, and Maaseiah, and Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, the gatekeepers.

verses.kjv: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were appointed to sound with cymbals of brass;
verses.decoded: So the singers, Heman, Asaph, and Ethan, were assigned to play the bronze cymbals;

verses.kjv: And Zechariah, and Aziel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Unni, and Eliab, and Maaseiah, and Benaiah, with psalteries on Alamoth;
verses.decoded: And Zechariah, Aziel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Unni, Eliab, Maaseiah, and Benaiah played psalteries tuned to Alamoth;

verses.kjv: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah, with harps on the Sheminith to excel.
verses.decoded: And Mattithiah, and Elipheleh, and Mikneiah, and Obed-edom, and Jeiel, and Azaziah played harps tuned to the Sheminith to perform excellently.

verses.kjv: And Chenaniah, chief of the Levites, was for song: he instructed about the song, because he was skilful.
verses.decoded: Chenaniah, the leader of the Levites, was in charge of the singing; he gave instructions about the songs because he was skilled.

verses.kjv: And Berechiah and Elkanah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.decoded: Berechiah and Elkanah were gatekeepers for the ark.

verses.kjv: And Shebaniah, and Jehoshaphat, and Nethaneel, and Amasai, and Zechariah, and Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, did blow with the trumpets before the ark of God: and Obed-edom and Jehiah were doorkeepers for the ark.
verses.decoded: Shebaniah, Jehoshaphat, Nethaneel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets in front of the ark of God. Obed-edom and Jehiah served as gatekeepers for the ark.

verses.kjv: So David, and the elders of Israel, and the captains over thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the Lord out of the house of Obed-edom with joy.
verses.decoded: So David, along with the elders of Israel and the commanders of thousands, went to bring up the ark of the covenant of the LORD from the house of Obed-edom with joy.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, when God helped the Levites that bare the ark of the covenant of the Lord, that they offered seven bullocks and seven rams.
verses.decoded: It happened that when God helped the Levites who carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD, they offered seven bulls and seven rams.

verses.kjv: And David was clothed with a robe of fine linen, and all the Levites that bare the ark, and the singers, and Chenaniah the master of the song with the singers: David also had upon him an ephod of linen.
verses.decoded: David was dressed in a robe made of fine linen, along with all the Levites who carried the ark, the singers, and Chenaniah, the leader of the music with the singers. David also wore a linen ephod.

verses.kjv: Thus all Israel brought up the ark of the covenant of the Lord with shouting, and with sound of the cornet, and with trumpets, and with cymbals, making a noise with psalteries and harps.
verses.decoded: So all Israel carried the ark of the covenant of the LORD with loud shouting, and with the sound of the horn, trumpets, and cymbals, making music with lyres and harps.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, as the ark of the covenant of the Lord came to the city of David, that Michal the daughter of Saul looking out at a window saw king David dancing and playing: and she despised him in her heart.
verses.decoded: When the ark of the covenant of the LORD arrived at the city of David, Michal, the daughter of Saul, looked out of a window and saw King David dancing and celebrating. She felt contempt for him in her heart.

verses.kjv: So they brought the ark of God, and set it in the midst of the tent that David had pitched for it: and they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings before God.
verses.decoded: So they brought the ark of God and placed it in the middle of the tent that David had set up for it. Then they offered burnt sacrifices and peace offerings to God.

verses.kjv: And when David had made an end of offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the Lord.
verses.decoded: After David finished offering the burnt offerings and the peace offerings, he blessed the people in the name of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And he dealt to every one of Israel, both man and woman, to every one a loaf of bread, and a good piece of flesh, and a flagon of wine.
verses.decoded: He gave to every person in Israel, both men and women, a loaf of bread, a good piece of meat, and a container of wine.

verses.kjv: And he appointed certain of the Levites to minister before the ark of the Lord, and to record, and to thank and praise the Lord God of Israel:
verses.decoded: He assigned some of the Levites to serve in front of the ark of the LORD, to keep records, and to thank and praise the LORD God of Israel.

verses.kjv: Asaph the chief, and next to him Zechariah, Jeiel, and Shemiramoth, and Jehiel, and Mattithiah, and Eliab, and Benaiah, and Obed-edom: and Jeiel with psalteries and with harps; but Asaph made a sound with cymbals;
verses.decoded: Asaph was the leader, and next to him were Zechariah, Jeiel, Shemiramoth, Jehiel, Mattithiah, Eliab, Benaiah, and Obed-edom. Jeiel played the psalteries and harps, but Asaph made a sound with cymbals.

verses.kjv: Benaiah also and Jahaziel the priests with trumpets continually before the ark of the covenant of God.
verses.decoded: Benaiah and Jahaziel, the priests, were with trumpets continually in front of the ark of the covenant of God.

verses.kjv: Then on that day David delivered first this psalm to thank the Lord into the hand of Asaph and his brethren.
verses.decoded: Then on that day David gave this psalm of thanksgiving to the LORD to Asaph and his brothers.

verses.kjv: Give thanks unto the Lord, call upon his name, make known his deeds among the people.
verses.decoded: Give thanks to the LORD, call on his name, and tell the people about what he has done.

verses.kjv: Sing unto him, sing psalms unto him, talk ye of all his wondrous works.
verses.decoded: Sing to him, sing psalms to him, speak about all his amazing works.

verses.kjv: Glory ye in his holy name: let the heart of them rejoice that seek the Lord.
verses.decoded: Be proud of his holy name; let the hearts of those who seek the LORD be joyful.

verses.kjv: Seek the Lord and his strength, seek his face continually.
verses.decoded: Look for the LORD and his power, look for his presence all the time.

verses.kjv: Remember his marvellous works that he hath done, his wonders, and the judgments of his mouth;
verses.decoded: Remember the amazing things he has done, his miracles, and the decisions he has spoken;

verses.kjv: O ye seed of Israel his servant, ye children of Jacob, his chosen ones.
verses.decoded: O descendants of Israel his servant, children of Jacob, his chosen people.

verses.kjv: He is the Lord our God; his judgments are in all the earth.
verses.decoded: He is the LORD our God; his decisions are everywhere in the world.

verses.kjv: Be ye mindful always of his covenant; the word which he commanded to a thousand generations;
verses.decoded: Always remember his covenant; the command he gave to a thousand generations;

verses.kjv: Even of the covenant which he made with Abraham, and of his oath unto Isaac;
verses.decoded: Even the agreement that God made with Abraham, and the promise he made to Isaac;

verses.kjv: And hath confirmed the same to Jacob for a law, and to Israel for an everlasting covenant,
verses.decoded: And has confirmed the same to Jacob as a law, and to Israel as an everlasting covenant,

verses.kjv: Saying, Unto thee will I give the land of Canaan, the lot of your inheritance;
verses.decoded: Saying, I will give you the land of Canaan, the portion of your inheritance;

verses.kjv: When ye were but few, even a few, and strangers in it.
verses.decoded: When you were only a few, just a few, and foreigners in it.

verses.kjv: And when they went from nation to nation, and from one kingdom to another people;
verses.decoded: And when they traveled from one nation to another, and from one kingdom to another group of people;

verses.kjv: He suffered no man to do them wrong: yea, he reproved kings for their sakes,
verses.decoded: He did not allow anyone to harm them; in fact, he corrected kings because of them.

verses.kjv: Saying, Touch not mine anointed, and do my prophets no harm.
verses.decoded: Saying, Do not harm my chosen ones, and do not hurt my prophets.

verses.kjv: Sing unto the Lord, all the earth; shew forth from day to day his salvation.
verses.decoded: Sing to the LORD, all the earth; declare his salvation every day.

verses.kjv: Declare his glory among the heathen; his marvellous works among all nations.
verses.decoded: Tell about his glory to the non-Jewish people; tell about his amazing works to all the nations.

verses.kjv: For great is the Lord, and greatly to be praised: he also is to be feared above all gods.
verses.decoded: For the LORD is great and should be praised greatly; he should also be respected more than all other gods.

verses.kjv: For all the gods of the people are idols: but the Lord made the heavens.
verses.decoded: All the gods of the nations are idols, but the LORD created the heavens.

verses.kjv: Glory and honour are in his presence; strength and gladness are in his place.
verses.decoded: Glory and honor are with him; power and joy are in his presence.

verses.kjv: Give unto the Lord, ye kindreds of the people, give unto the Lord glory and strength.
verses.decoded: Give to the LORD, all families of the people, give to the LORD glory and strength.

verses.kjv: Give unto the Lord the glory due unto his name: bring an offering, and come before him: worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness.
verses.decoded: Give the LORD the glory that belongs to his name: bring an offering and come before him: worship the LORD in the beauty of holiness.

verses.kjv: Fear before him, all the earth: the world also shall be stable, that it be not moved.
verses.decoded: Respect him, all the earth; the world will also be steady and will not be shaken.

verses.kjv: Let the heavens be glad, and let the earth rejoice: and let men say among the nations, The Lord reigneth.
verses.decoded: Let the sky be happy, and let the earth celebrate; and let people say among the nations, The LORD rules.

verses.kjv: Let the sea roar, and the fulness thereof: let the fields rejoice, and all that is therein.
verses.decoded: Let the sea make noise, and everything in it; let the fields be glad, and everything in them.

verses.kjv: Then shall the trees of the wood sing out at the presence of the Lord, because he cometh to judge the earth.
verses.decoded: Then the trees of the forest will sing loudly in the presence of the LORD, because he is coming to judge the earth.

verses.kjv: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good; for his mercy endureth for ever.
verses.decoded: Give thanks to the LORD because he is good; his mercy lasts forever.

verses.kjv: And say ye, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the heathen, that we may give thanks to thy holy name, and glory in thy praise.
verses.decoded: And say, Save us, O God of our salvation, and gather us together, and deliver us from the nations, so that we may give thanks to your holy name, and take pride in your praise.

verses.kjv: Blessed be the Lord God of Israel for ever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the Lord.
verses.decoded: Praise the LORD God of Israel forever and ever. And all the people said, Amen, and praised the LORD.

verses.kjv: So he left there before the ark of the covenant of the Lord Asaph and his brethren, to minister before the ark continually, as every day’s work required:
verses.decoded: So he left Asaph and his brothers there in front of the ark of the covenant of the LORD to serve in front of the ark continually, as the daily work required.

verses.kjv: And Obed-edom with their brethren, threescore and eight; Obed-edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah to be porters:
verses.decoded: And Obed-edom with their brothers, sixty-eight; Obed-edom also the son of Jeduthun and Hosah were to be gatekeepers:

verses.kjv: And Zadok the priest, and his brethren the priests, before the tabernacle of the Lord in the high place that was at Gibeon,
verses.decoded: And Zadok the priest, along with his fellow priests, stood in front of the LORD's tabernacle at the high place located in Gibeon,

verses.kjv: To offer burnt offerings unto the Lord upon the altar of the burnt offering continually morning and evening, and to do according to all that is written in the law of the Lord, which he commanded Israel;
verses.decoded: To offer burnt offerings to the LORD on the altar of burnt offering continually every morning and evening, and to do everything written in the law of the LORD, which he commanded Israel;

verses.kjv: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the rest that were chosen, who were expressed by name, to give thanks to the Lord, because his mercy endureth for ever;
verses.decoded: And with them Heman and Jeduthun, and the others who were chosen and named, to give thanks to the LORD, because his mercy lasts forever;

verses.kjv: And with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should make a sound, and with musical instruments of God. And the sons of Jeduthun were porters.
verses.decoded: And with them were Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those who were to make sound, and with musical instruments of God. The sons of Jeduthun were gatekeepers.

verses.kjv: And all the people departed every man to his house: and David returned to bless his house.
verses.decoded: And all the people left, each one going to his own house; and David went back to bless his own house.

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass, as David sat in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Lo, I dwell in an house of cedars, but the ark of the covenant of the Lord remaineth under curtains.
verses.decoded: Now it happened, while David was sitting in his house, that David said to Nathan the prophet, Look, I live in a house made of cedar, but the ark of the covenant of the LORD stays under curtains.

verses.kjv: Then Nathan said unto David, Do all that is in thine heart; for God is with thee.
verses.decoded: Then Nathan said to David, Do everything that is in your heart; because God is with you.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass the same night, that the word of God came to Nathan, saying,
verses.decoded: That same night, the word of God came to Nathan, saying,

verses.kjv: Go and tell David my servant, Thus saith the Lord, Thou shalt not build me an house to dwell in:
verses.decoded: Go and tell David my servant, This is what the LORD says, You will not build me a house to live in:

verses.kjv: For I have not dwelt in an house since the day that I brought up Israel unto this day; but have gone from tent to tent, and from one tabernacle to another.
verses.decoded: For I have not lived in a house since the day I brought Israel up until today; instead, I have moved from one tent to another, and from one tabernacle to another.

verses.kjv: Wheresoever I have walked with all Israel, spake I a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to feed my people, saying, Why have ye not built me an house of cedars?
verses.decoded: Wherever I have gone with all Israel, have I spoken a word to any of the judges of Israel, whom I commanded to take care of my people, saying, Why have you not built me a house of cedar wood?

verses.kjv: Now therefore thus shalt thou say unto my servant David, Thus saith the Lord of hosts, I took thee from the sheepcote, even from following the sheep, that thou shouldest be ruler over my people Israel:
verses.decoded: Now, therefore, you shall say to my servant David, This is what the LORD of hosts says: I took you from tending the sheep, even from following the sheep, to make you ruler over my people Israel.

verses.kjv: And I have been with thee whithersoever thou hast walked, and have cut off all thine enemies from before thee, and have made thee a name like the name of the great men that are in the earth.
verses.decoded: And I have been with you wherever you have gone, and have destroyed all your enemies in front of you, and have made your name as famous as the names of the great men on the earth.

verses.kjv: Also I will ordain a place for my people Israel, and will plant them, and they shall dwell in their place, and shall be moved no more; neither shall the children of wickedness waste them any more, as at the beginning,
verses.decoded: Also I will establish a place for my people Israel, and I will settle them, and they will live in their place, and they will not be moved again; nor will the children of evil destroy them anymore, as they did at the beginning,

verses.kjv: And since the time that I commanded judges to be over my people Israel. Moreover I will subdue all thine enemies. Furthermore I tell thee that the Lord will build thee an house.
verses.decoded: Since the time I appointed judges to lead my people Israel, I will also defeat all your enemies. Additionally, I tell you that the LORD will build a house for you.

verses.kjv: And it shall come to pass, when thy days be expired that thou must go to be with thy fathers, that I will raise up thy seed after thee, which shall be of thy sons; and I will establish his kingdom.
verses.decoded: And it will happen, when your days are finished and you must go to be with your ancestors, that I will raise up your offspring after you, one of your sons; and I will establish his kingdom.

verses.kjv: He shall build me an house, and I will stablish his throne for ever.
verses.decoded: He will build a house for me, and I will establish his throne forever.

verses.kjv: I will be his father, and he shall be my son: and I will not take my mercy away from him, as I took it from him that was before thee:
verses.decoded: I will be his father, and he will be my son; and I will not remove my kindness from him, as I removed it from the one who was before you.

verses.kjv: But I will settle him in mine house and in my kingdom for ever: and his throne shall be established for evermore.
verses.decoded: But I will establish him in my house and in my kingdom forever; and his throne will be established forever.

verses.kjv: According to all these words, and according to all this vision, so did Nathan speak unto David.
verses.decoded: In accordance with all these words and all this vision, Nathan spoke to David.

verses.kjv: And David the king came and sat before the Lord, and said, Who am I, O Lord God, and what is mine house, that thou hast brought me hitherto?
verses.decoded: Then King David came and sat in the presence of the LORD and said, Who am I, Lord God, and what is my family, that you have brought me this far?

verses.kjv: And yet this was a small thing in thine eyes, O God; for thou hast also spoken of thy servant’s house for a great while to come, and hast regarded me according to the estate of a man of high degree, O Lord God.
verses.decoded: And yet this is a small thing in your eyes, O God; because you have also spoken about your servant’s family for a long time to come, and you have treated me like a man of high rank, O LORD God.

verses.kjv: What can David speak more to thee for the honour of thy servant? for thou knowest thy servant.
verses.decoded: What else can David say to you to honor your servant? For you know your servant.

verses.kjv: O Lord, for thy servant’s sake, and according to thine own heart, hast thou done all this greatness, in making known all these great things.
verses.decoded: O LORD, because of your servant and according to your own heart, you have done all this greatness by revealing all these great things.

verses.kjv: O Lord, there is none like thee, neither is there any God beside thee, according to all that we have heard with our ears.
verses.decoded: O LORD, there is no one like you, and there is no God besides you, as we have heard with our own ears.

verses.kjv: And what one nation in the earth is like thy people Israel, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make thee a name of greatness and terribleness, by driving out nations from before thy people, whom thou hast redeemed out of Egypt?
verses.decoded: And what one nation on earth is like your people Israel, whom God went to redeem to be his own people, to make you a name of greatness and fear, by driving out nations from before your people, whom you have redeemed out of Egypt?

verses.kjv: For thy people Israel didst thou make thine own people for ever; and thou, Lord, becamest their God.
verses.decoded: You made your people Israel your own people forever; and you, LORD, became their God.

verses.kjv: Therefore now, Lord, let the thing that thou hast spoken concerning thy servant and concerning his house be established for ever, and do as thou hast said.
verses.decoded: So now, LORD, let what you have spoken about your servant and his family be established forever, and do as you have promised.

verses.kjv: Let it even be established, that thy name may be magnified for ever, saying, The Lord of hosts is the God of Israel, even a God to Israel: and let the house of David thy servant be established before thee.
verses.decoded: Let it be established so that your name may be praised forever, saying, The LORD of hosts is the God of Israel, truly a God to Israel; and let the house of David your servant be established in your presence.

verses.kjv: For thou, O my God, hast told thy servant that thou wilt build him an house: therefore thy servant hath found in his heart to pray before thee.
verses.decoded: For you, O my God, have told your servant that you will build him a house; therefore your servant has decided to pray before you.

verses.kjv: And now, Lord, thou art God, and hast promised this goodness unto thy servant:
verses.decoded: And now, LORD, you are God, and you have promised this goodness to your servant:

verses.kjv: Now therefore let it please thee to bless the house of thy servant, that it may be before thee for ever: for thou blessest, O Lord, and it shall be blessed for ever.
verses.decoded: Now then, please bless the house of your servant, so that it may be in your presence forever; because you bless, O LORD, and it will be blessed forever.

verses.kjv: Now after this it came to pass, that David smote the Philistines, and subdued them, and took Gath and her towns out of the hand of the Philistines.
verses.decoded: After this, David defeated the Philistines, conquered them, and took Gath and its towns away from the Philistines.

verses.kjv: And he smote Moab; and the Moabites became David’s servants, and brought gifts.
verses.decoded: He defeated Moab, and the Moabites became servants of David and brought gifts.

verses.kjv: And David smote Hadarezer king of Zobah unto Hamath, as he went to stablish his dominion by the river Euphrates.
verses.decoded: And David defeated Hadarezer, king of Zobah, as far as Hamath, while he was going to secure his control by the Euphrates River.

verses.kjv: And David took from him a thousand chariots, and seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand footmen: David also houghed all the chariot horses, but reserved of them an hundred chariots.
verses.decoded: And David took from him a thousand chariots, seven thousand horsemen, and twenty thousand foot soldiers. David also disabled all the chariot horses by cutting their tendons, but he kept one hundred chariots.

verses.kjv: And when the Syrians of Damascus came to help Hadarezer king of Zobah, David slew of the Syrians two and twenty thousand men.
verses.decoded: When the Syrians from Damascus came to help Hadarezer, king of Zobah, David killed twenty-two thousand of the Syrians.

verses.kjv: Then David put garrisons in Syria-damascus; and the Syrians became David’s servants, and brought gifts. Thus the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.decoded: Then David stationed troops in Syria-Damascus; and the Syrians became David’s servants and brought gifts. In this way, the LORD protected David wherever he went.

verses.kjv: And David took the shields of gold that were on the servants of Hadarezer, and brought them to Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: David took the gold shields that were on the servants of Hadarezer and brought them to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Likewise from Tibhath, and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, brought David very much brass, wherewith Solomon made the brasen sea, and the pillars, and the vessels of brass.
verses.decoded: Similarly, from Tibhath and from Chun, cities of Hadarezer, David received a large amount of bronze, which Solomon used to make the bronze sea, the pillars, and the bronze vessels.

verses.kjv: Now when Tou king of Hamath heard how David had smitten all the host of Hadarezer king of Zobah;
verses.decoded: When Tou, king of Hamath, heard that David had defeated the entire army of Hadarezer, king of Zobah,

verses.kjv: He sent Hadoram his son to king David, to inquire of his welfare, and to congratulate him, because he had fought against Hadarezer, and smitten him; (for Hadarezer had war with Tou;) and with him all manner of vessels of gold and silver and brass.
verses.decoded: He sent Hadoram his son to King David to ask how he was doing and to congratulate him because he had fought against Hadarezer and defeated him; (for Hadarezer was at war with Toi;) and with him were all kinds of vessels made of gold, silver, and bronze.

verses.kjv: Them also king David dedicated unto the Lord, with the silver and the gold that he brought from all these nations; from Edom, and from Moab, and from the children of Ammon, and from the Philistines, and from Amalek.
verses.decoded: King David also dedicated them to the LORD, along with the silver and gold that he brought from all these nations: from Edom, from Moab, from the people of Ammon, from the Philistines, and from Amalek.

verses.kjv: Moreover Abishai the son of Zeruiah slew of the Edomites in the valley of salt eighteen thousand.
verses.decoded: Also, Abishai, the son of Zeruiah, killed eighteen thousand Edomites in the Valley of Salt.

verses.kjv: And he put garrisons in Edom; and all the Edomites became David’s servants. Thus the Lord preserved David whithersoever he went.
verses.decoded: He stationed military forces in Edom, and all the Edomites became servants of David. In this way, the LORD protected David wherever he went.

verses.kjv: So David reigned over all Israel, and executed judgment and justice among all his people.
