verses.decoded: So David ruled over all Israel and carried out fair decisions and justice among all his people.

verses.kjv: And Joab the son of Zeruiah was over the host; and Jehoshaphat the son of Ahilud, recorder.
verses.decoded: And Joab, the son of Zeruiah, was in charge of the army; and Jehoshaphat, the son of Ahilud, was the recorder.

verses.kjv: And Zadok the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech the son of Abiathar, were the priests; and Shavsha was scribe;
verses.decoded: Zadok, the son of Ahitub, and Abimelech, the son of Abiathar, were the priests, and Shavsha was the secretary.

verses.kjv: And Benaiah the son of Jehoiada was over the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and the sons of David were chief about the king.
verses.decoded: Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, was in charge of the Cherethites and the Pelethites; and David's sons were leaders around the king.

verses.kjv: Now it came to pass after this, that Nahash the king of the children of Ammon died, and his son reigned in his stead.
verses.decoded: After this happened, Nahash, the king of the Ammonites, died, and his son became king in his place.

verses.kjv: And David said, I will shew kindness unto Hanun the son of Nahash, because his father shewed kindness to me. And David sent messengers to comfort him concerning his father. So the servants of David came into the land of the children of Ammon to Hanun, to comfort him.
verses.decoded: And David said, I will show kindness to Hanun, the son of Nahash, because his father showed kindness to me. So David sent messengers to comfort him about his father. The servants of David went into the land of the people of Ammon to Hanun to comfort him.

verses.kjv: But the princes of the children of Ammon said to Hanun, Thinkest thou that David doth honour thy father, that he hath sent comforters unto thee? are not his servants come unto thee for to search, and to overthrow, and to spy out the land?
verses.decoded: But the leaders of the Ammonites said to Hanun, Do you think that David respects your father, that he has sent messengers to comfort you? Haven't his servants come to you to investigate, to destroy, and to spy out the land?

verses.kjv: Wherefore Hanun took David’s servants, and shaved them, and cut off their garments in the midst hard by their buttocks, and sent them away.
verses.decoded: Therefore Hanun took David’s servants, shaved their heads, cut off their clothes around the middle near their buttocks, and sent them away.

verses.kjv: Then there went certain, and told David how the men were served. And he sent to meet them: for the men were greatly ashamed. And the king said, Tarry at Jericho until your beards be grown, and then return.
verses.decoded: Then some people went and told David how the men had been treated. He sent someone to meet them because the men were very ashamed. The king said, "Stay in Jericho until your beards have grown back, and then come back."

verses.kjv: And when the children of Ammon saw that they had made themselves odious to David, Hanun and the children of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire them chariots and horsemen out of Mesopotamia, and out of Syria-maachah, and out of Zobah.
verses.decoded: When the people of Ammon saw that they had made themselves hated by David, Hanun and the people of Ammon sent a thousand talents of silver to hire chariots and horsemen from Mesopotamia, from Syria-maachah, and from Zobah.

verses.kjv: So they hired thirty and two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and pitched before Medeba. And the children of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to battle.
verses.decoded: So they hired thirty-two thousand chariots, and the king of Maachah and his people; who came and camped in front of Medeba. And the people of Ammon gathered themselves together from their cities, and came to fight.

verses.kjv: And when David heard of it, he sent Joab, and all the host of the mighty men.
verses.decoded: When David heard about it, he sent Joab and all the army of the strong warriors.

verses.kjv: And the children of Ammon came out, and put the battle in array before the gate of the city: and the kings that were come were by themselves in the field.
verses.decoded: The people of Ammon came out and arranged their army in battle formation in front of the city gate, while the kings who had arrived stayed together in the open field.

verses.kjv: Now when Joab saw that the battle was set against him before and behind, he chose out of all the choice of Israel, and put them in array against the Syrians.
verses.decoded: When Joab saw that the battle was arranged against him both in front and behind, he selected the best soldiers from all of Israel and arranged them to fight against the Syrians.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the people he delivered unto the hand of Abishai his brother, and they set themselves in array against the children of Ammon.
verses.decoded: He gave the rest of the people into the control of Abishai his brother, and they arranged themselves in battle formation against the people of Ammon.

verses.kjv: And he said, If the Syrians be too strong for me, then thou shalt help me: but if the children of Ammon be too strong for thee, then I will help thee.
verses.decoded: And he said, If the Syrians are too strong for me, then you will help me; but if the children of Ammon are too strong for you, then I will help you.

verses.kjv: Be of good courage, and let us behave ourselves valiantly for our people, and for the cities of our God: and let the Lord do that which is good in his sight.
verses.decoded: Be brave, and let us act courageously for our people and for the cities of our God; and let the LORD do what is good in his eyes.

verses.kjv: So Joab and the people that were with him drew nigh before the Syrians unto the battle; and they fled before him.
verses.decoded: So Joab and the people with him approached the Syrians for battle, and the Syrians ran away from them.

verses.kjv: And when the children of Ammon saw that the Syrians were fled, they likewise fled before Abishai his brother, and entered into the city. Then Joab came to Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: When the people of Ammon saw that the Syrians had run away, they also ran away from Abishai, his brother, and went into the city. Then Joab returned to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And when the Syrians saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they sent messengers, and drew forth the Syrians that were beyond the river: and Shophach the captain of the host of Hadarezer went before them.
verses.decoded: When the Syrians saw that they were defeated by Israel, they sent messengers and brought out the Syrians who were beyond the river. Shophach, the commander of Hadarezer's army, went ahead of them.

verses.kjv: And it was told David; and he gathered all Israel, and passed over Jordan, and came upon them, and set the battle in array against them. So when David had put the battle in array against the Syrians, they fought with him.
verses.decoded: The news was told to David, and he gathered all Israel, crossed the Jordan River, came upon them, and arranged his army for battle against them. When David had arranged his army against the Syrians, they fought against him.

verses.kjv: But the Syrians fled before Israel; and David slew of the Syrians seven thousand men which fought in chariots, and forty thousand footmen, and killed Shophach the captain of the host.
verses.decoded: But the Syrians ran away from Israel; and David killed seven thousand of the Syrians who fought in chariots, and forty thousand foot soldiers, and he killed Shophach, the commander of their army.

verses.kjv: And when the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were put to the worse before Israel, they made peace with David, and became his servants: neither would the Syrians help the children of Ammon any more.
verses.decoded: When the servants of Hadarezer saw that they were defeated by Israel, they made peace with David and became his servants; the Syrians also stopped helping the people of Ammon.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass, that after the year was expired, at the time that kings go out to battle, Joab led forth the power of the army, and wasted the country of the children of Ammon, and came and besieged Rabbah. But David tarried at Jerusalem. And Joab smote Rabbah, and destroyed it.
verses.decoded: After the year ended, at the time when kings go out to battle, Joab led the army and devastated the land of the Ammonites, then came and laid siege to Rabbah. But David stayed in Jerusalem. Joab attacked Rabbah and destroyed it.

verses.kjv: And David took the crown of their king from off his head, and found it to weigh a talent of gold, and there were precious stones in it; and it was set upon David’s head: and he brought also exceeding much spoil out of the city.
verses.decoded: And David took the crown of their king from his head, and it weighed a talent of gold, with precious stones in it; and he placed it on David’s head. He also brought out a very large amount of plunder from the city.

verses.kjv: And he brought out the people that were in it, and cut them with saws, and with harrows of iron, and with axes. Even so dealt David with all the cities of the children of Ammon. And David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: He brought out the people who were inside and killed them using saws, iron harrows, and axes. David treated all the cities of the Ammonites in the same way. Then David and all the people returned to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And it came to pass after this, that there arose war at Gezer with the Philistines; at which time Sibbechai the Hushathite slew Sippai, that was of the children of the giant: and they were subdued.
verses.decoded: After this, there was a war at Gezer against the Philistines; during that time, Sibbechai the Hushathite killed Sippai, who was one of the descendants of the giant, and they were defeated.

verses.kjv: And there was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan the son of Jair slew Lahmi the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear staff was like a weaver’s beam.
verses.decoded: There was war again with the Philistines; and Elhanan, the son of Jair, killed Lahmi, the brother of Goliath the Gittite, whose spear shaft was like a weaver’s beam.

verses.kjv: And yet again there was war at Gath, where was a man of great stature, whose fingers and toes were four and twenty, six on each hand, and six on each foot: and he also was the son of the giant.
verses.decoded: And again there was a battle at Gath, where there was a very tall man who had twenty-four fingers and toes, six on each hand and six on each foot; he was also a descendant of the giants.

verses.kjv: But when he defied Israel, Jonathan the son of Shimea David’s brother slew him.
verses.decoded: But when he rebelled against Israel, Jonathan, the son of Shimea, David’s brother, killed him.

verses.kjv: These were born unto the giant in Gath; and they fell by the hand of David, and by the hand of his servants.
verses.decoded: These were born to the giant in Gath; and they were killed by David and by his servants.

verses.kjv: And Satan stood up against Israel, and provoked David to number Israel.
verses.decoded: Satan stood against Israel and caused David to count the people of Israel.

verses.kjv: And David said to Joab and to the rulers of the people, Go, number Israel from Beer-sheba even to Dan; and bring the number of them to me, that I may know it.
verses.decoded: David said to Joab and to the leaders of the people, Go and count the people of Israel from Beer-sheba to Dan; and bring the total number to me so that I may know it.

verses.kjv: And Joab answered, The Lord make his people an hundred times so many more as they be: but, my lord the king, are they not all my lord’s servants? why then doth my lord require this thing? why will he be a cause of trespass to Israel?
verses.decoded: And Joab answered, May the LORD give his people a hundred times as many as they are now; but, my lord the king, aren’t they all your servants? So why do you want this? Why would you cause sin against Israel?

verses.kjv: Nevertheless the king’s word prevailed against Joab. Wherefore Joab departed, and went throughout all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: But the king's command won over Joab. So Joab left, went through all Israel, and came to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: And Joab gave the sum of the number of the people unto David. And all they of Israel were a thousand thousand and an hundred thousand men that drew sword: and Judah was four hundred threescore and ten thousand men that drew sword.
verses.decoded: And Joab gave the total number of the people to David. All the men of Israel who drew the sword were one million one hundred thousand; and Judah had four hundred seventy thousand men who drew the sword.

verses.kjv: But Levi and Benjamin counted he not among them: for the king’s word was abominable to Joab.
verses.decoded: But he did not include Levi and Benjamin in the count because Joab hated the king’s command.

verses.kjv: And God was displeased with this thing; therefore he smote Israel.
verses.decoded: God was unhappy about this, so he struck Israel.

verses.kjv: And David said unto God, I have sinned greatly, because I have done this thing: but now, I beseech thee, do away the iniquity of thy servant; for I have done very foolishly.
verses.decoded: And David said to God, I have sinned greatly because I have done this thing; but now, I ask you, remove the sin of your servant, because I have acted very foolishly.

verses.kjv: And the Lord spake unto Gad, David’s seer, saying,
verses.decoded: And the LORD spoke to Gad, David’s prophet, saying,

verses.kjv: Go and tell David, saying, Thus saith the Lord, I offer thee three things: choose thee one of them, that I may do it unto thee.
verses.decoded: Go and tell David, saying, This is what the LORD says: I am offering you three things; choose one of them, so that I may do it for you.

verses.kjv: So Gad came to David, and said unto him, Thus saith the Lord, Choose thee
verses.decoded: So Gad came to David and said to him, This is what the LORD says, Choose for yourself

verses.kjv: Either three years’ famine; or three months to be destroyed before thy foes, while that the sword of thine enemies overtaketh thee; or else three days the sword of the Lord, even the pestilence, in the land, and the angel of the Lord destroying throughout all the coasts of Israel. Now therefore advise thyself what word I shall bring again to him that sent me.
verses.decoded: Either three years of famine; or three months of being defeated by your enemies while the sword of your enemies overtakes you; or else three days of the LORD's sword, which is the plague in the land, and the angel of the LORD destroying throughout all the borders of Israel. Now then, decide what message I should bring back to the one who sent me.

verses.kjv: And David said unto Gad, I am in a great strait: let me fall now into the hand of the Lord; for very great are his mercies: but let me not fall into the hand of man.
verses.decoded: And David said to Gad, I am in a serious situation: let me now fall into the hand of the LORD; because his mercies are very great: but let me not fall into the hand of humans.

verses.kjv: So the Lord sent pestilence upon Israel: and there fell of Israel seventy thousand men.
verses.decoded: So the LORD sent a plague on Israel, and seventy thousand men of Israel died.

verses.kjv: And God sent an angel unto Jerusalem to destroy it: and as he was destroying, the Lord beheld, and he repented him of the evil, and said to the angel that destroyed, It is enough, stay now thine hand. And the angel of the Lord stood by the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.decoded: And God sent an angel to Jerusalem to destroy it; and while he was destroying, the LORD saw it and changed his mind about the disaster, and said to the angel who was destroying, 'That is enough, stop now your hand.' And the angel of the LORD was standing by the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

verses.kjv: And David lifted up his eyes, and saw the angel of the Lord stand between the earth and the heaven, having a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the elders of Israel, who were clothed in sackcloth, fell upon their faces.
verses.decoded: David looked up and saw the angel of the LORD standing between the earth and the sky, holding a drawn sword in his hand stretched out over Jerusalem. Then David and the leaders of Israel, who were wearing sackcloth, fell face down.

verses.kjv: And David said unto God, Is it not I that commanded the people to be numbered? even I it is that have sinned and done evil indeed; but as for these sheep, what have they done? let thine hand, I pray thee, O Lord my God, be on me, and on my father’s house; but not on thy people, that they should be plagued.
verses.decoded: And David said to God, Is it not I who commanded the people to be counted? It is I who have sinned and done wrong; but what have these sheep done? Please let your hand, O LORD my God, be on me and on my father’s family, but not on your people so that they suffer.

verses.kjv: Then the angel of the Lord commanded Gad to say to David, that David should go up, and set up an altar unto the Lord in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite.
verses.decoded: Then the angel of the LORD told Gad to tell David that David should go up and build an altar to the LORD on the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite.

verses.kjv: And David went up at the saying of Gad, which he spake in the name of the Lord.
verses.decoded: And David went up as Gad said, who spoke in the name of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And Ornan turned back, and saw the angel; and his four sons with him hid themselves. Now Ornan was threshing wheat.
verses.decoded: Ornan turned around and saw the angel; his four sons with him hid themselves. At that time, Ornan was threshing wheat.

verses.kjv: And as David came to Ornan, Ornan looked and saw David, and went out of the threshingfloor, and bowed himself to David with his face to the ground.
verses.decoded: When David arrived at Ornan's place, Ornan saw David, came out from the threshing floor, and bowed down to David with his face touching the ground.

verses.kjv: Then David said to Ornan, Grant me the place of this threshingfloor, that I may build an altar therein unto the Lord: thou shalt grant it me for the full price: that the plague may be stayed from the people.
verses.decoded: Then David said to Ornan, Give me the place of this threshing floor, so I can build an altar there to the LORD. You must sell it to me at the full price, so the plague can be stopped from the people.

verses.kjv: And Ornan said unto David, Take it to thee, and let my lord the king do that which is good in his eyes: lo, I give thee the oxen also for burnt offerings, and the threshing instruments for wood, and the wheat for the meat offering; I give it all.
verses.decoded: And Ornan said to David, Take it for yourself, and let my lord the king do whatever he thinks is right: look, I give you the oxen for burnt offerings, the threshing tools for wood, and the wheat for the grain offering; I give it all.

verses.kjv: And king David said to Ornan, Nay; but I will verily buy it for the full price: for I will not take that which is thine for the Lord, nor offer burnt offerings without cost.
verses.decoded: And King David said to Ornan, No; but I will definitely buy it for the full price, because I will not take what belongs to you for the LORD, nor offer burnt offerings without paying for them.

verses.kjv: So David gave to Ornan for the place six hundred shekels of gold by weight.
verses.decoded: So David gave Ornan six hundred shekels of gold by weight for the place.

verses.kjv: And David built there an altar unto the Lord, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and called upon the Lord; and he answered him from heaven by fire upon the altar of burnt offering.
verses.decoded: And David built an altar to the LORD there, and offered burnt offerings and peace offerings, and prayed to the LORD; and He answered him from heaven with fire on the altar of burnt offering.

verses.kjv: And the Lord commanded the angel; and he put up his sword again into the sheath thereof.
verses.decoded: The LORD commanded the angel, and he put his sword back into its sheath.

verses.kjv: At that time when David saw that the Lord had answered him in the threshingfloor of Ornan the Jebusite, then he sacrificed there.
verses.decoded: At that time, when David saw that the LORD had answered him at the threshing floor of Ornan the Jebusite, he offered a sacrifice there.

verses.kjv: For the tabernacle of the Lord, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar of the burnt offering, were at that season in the high place at Gibeon.
verses.decoded: At that time, the LORD's tabernacle, which Moses made in the wilderness, and the altar for burnt offerings were located at the high place in Gibeon.

verses.kjv: But David could not go before it to inquire of God: for he was afraid because of the sword of the angel of the Lord.
verses.decoded: But David could not go near it to ask God, because he was afraid of the sword of the angel of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Then David said, This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar of the burnt offering for Israel.
verses.decoded: Then David said, This is the house of the Lord God, and this is the altar for burnt offerings for Israel.

verses.kjv: And David commanded to gather together the strangers that were in the land of Israel; and he set masons to hew wrought stones to build the house of God.
verses.decoded: And David ordered to gather the foreigners who were living in the land of Israel; and he assigned masons to cut shaped stones to build the house of God.

verses.kjv: And David prepared iron in abundance for the nails for the doors of the gates, and for the joinings; and brass in abundance without weight;
verses.decoded: And David prepared a large amount of iron for the nails for the doors of the gates and for the fittings; and a large amount of bronze without measuring;

verses.kjv: Also cedar trees in abundance: for the Zidonians and they of Tyre brought much cedar wood to David.
verses.decoded: There were also many cedar trees because the Zidonians and the people of Tyre brought a lot of cedar wood to David.

verses.kjv: And David said, Solomon my son is young and tender, and the house that is to be builded for the Lord must be exceeding magnifical, of fame and of glory throughout all countries: I will therefore now make preparation for it. So David prepared abundantly before his death.
verses.decoded: And David said, Solomon my son is young and inexperienced, and the house that is to be built for the LORD must be extremely magnificent, famous, and glorious throughout all the nations: Therefore, I will now make preparations for it. So David prepared abundantly before he died.

verses.kjv: Then he called for Solomon his son, and charged him to build an house for the Lord God of Israel.
verses.decoded: Then he called his son Solomon and instructed him to build a house for the Lord God of Israel.

verses.kjv: And David said to Solomon, My son, as for me, it was in my mind to build an house unto the name of the Lord my God:
verses.decoded: And David said to Solomon, My son, I had planned to build a house for the name of the LORD my God:

verses.kjv: But the word of the Lord came to me, saying, Thou hast shed blood abundantly, and hast made great wars: thou shalt not build an house unto my name, because thou hast shed much blood upon the earth in my sight.
verses.decoded: But the word of the LORD came to me, saying, You have shed a lot of blood and have fought many great wars; you will not build a house for my name, because you have shed much blood on the earth in my sight.

verses.kjv: Behold, a son shall be born to thee, who shall be a man of rest; and I will give him rest from all his enemies round about: for his name shall be Solomon, and I will give peace and quietness unto Israel in his days.
verses.decoded: Look, a son will be born to you, who will be a man of peace; and I will give him rest from all his enemies around him: because his name will be Solomon, and I will give peace and calm to Israel during his lifetime.

verses.kjv: He shall build an house for my name; and he shall be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel for ever.
verses.decoded: He will build a house for my name; he will be my son, and I will be his father; and I will establish the throne of his kingdom over Israel forever.

verses.kjv: Now, my son, the Lord be with thee; and prosper thou, and build the house of the Lord thy God, as he hath said of thee.
verses.decoded: Now, my son, may the LORD be with you; may you succeed and build the house of the LORD your God, just as He has promised you.

verses.kjv: Only the Lord give thee wisdom and understanding, and give thee charge concerning Israel, that thou mayest keep the law of the Lord thy God.
verses.decoded: May the LORD give you wisdom and understanding, and give you responsibility over Israel, so that you may obey the law of the LORD your God.

verses.kjv: Then shalt thou prosper, if thou takest heed to fulfil the statutes and judgments which the Lord charged Moses with concerning Israel: be strong, and of good courage; dread not, nor be dismayed.
verses.decoded: Then you will succeed if you pay attention to obey the laws and rules that the LORD gave to Moses about Israel: be strong and courageous; do not be afraid or discouraged.

verses.kjv: Now, behold, in my trouble I have prepared for the house of the Lord an hundred thousand talents of gold, and a thousand thousand talents of silver; and of brass and iron without weight; for it is in abundance: timber also and stone have I prepared; and thou mayest add thereto.
verses.decoded: Now, look, during my difficulties I have prepared for the house of the LORD one hundred thousand talents of gold, and one million talents of silver; and brass and iron without measuring because there is so much; I have also prepared timber and stone; and you may add to it.

verses.kjv: Moreover there are workmen with thee in abundance, hewers and workers of stone and timber, and all manner of cunning men for every manner of work.
verses.decoded: Also, there are many workers with you, cutters and workers of stone and wood, and all kinds of skilled men for every type of work.

verses.kjv: Of the gold, the silver, and the brass, and the iron, there is no number. Arise therefore, and be doing, and the Lord be with thee.
verses.decoded: There is an unlimited amount of gold, silver, bronze, and iron. So get up and start working, and may the LORD be with you.

verses.kjv: David also commanded all the princes of Israel to help Solomon his son, saying,
verses.decoded: David also instructed all the leaders of Israel to assist Solomon his son, saying,

verses.kjv: Is not the Lord your God with you? and hath he not given you rest on every side? for he hath given the inhabitants of the land into mine hand; and the land is subdued before the Lord, and before his people.
verses.decoded: Is not the LORD your God with you? Has he not given you rest on every side? For he has given the people living in the land into my hand; and the land is conquered before the LORD and before his people.

verses.kjv: Now set your heart and your soul to seek the Lord your God; arise therefore, and build ye the sanctuary of the Lord God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that is to be built to the name of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Now focus your mind and your spirit on seeking the LORD your God; get up and build the sanctuary of the LORD God, to bring the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and the holy vessels of God, into the house that will be built in the name of the LORD.

verses.kjv: So when David was old and full of days, he made Solomon his son king over Israel.
verses.decoded: When David became old and had lived a long life, he made his son Solomon the king over Israel.

verses.kjv: And he gathered together all the princes of Israel, with the priests and the Levites.
verses.decoded: He gathered all the leaders of Israel, along with the priests and the Levites.

verses.kjv: Now the Levites were numbered from the age of thirty years and upward: and their number by their polls, man by man, was thirty and eight thousand.
verses.decoded: The Levites were counted starting from the age of thirty years and older: and their total number, counted one by one, was thirty-eight thousand.

verses.kjv: Of which, twenty and four thousand were to set forward the work of the house of the Lord; and six thousand were officers and judges:
verses.decoded: Out of these, twenty-four thousand were assigned to carry out the work of the house of the LORD; and six thousand were officials and judges:

verses.kjv: Moreover four thousand were porters; and four thousand praised the Lord with the instruments which I made, said David, to praise therewith.
verses.decoded: Also, four thousand were gatekeepers; and four thousand praised the LORD with the instruments that I made, said David, to praise with them.

verses.kjv: And David divided them into courses among the sons of Levi, namely, Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.
verses.decoded: David divided them into groups among the sons of Levi, specifically Gershon, Kohath, and Merari.

verses.kjv: Of the Gershonites were, Laadan, and Shimei.
verses.decoded: The Gershonites were Laadan and Shimei.

verses.kjv: The sons of Laadan; the chief was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.
verses.decoded: The sons of Laadan; the leader was Jehiel, and Zetham, and Joel, three.

verses.kjv: The sons of Shimei; Shelomith, and Haziel, and Haran, three. These were the chief of the fathers of Laadan.
verses.decoded: The sons of Shimei were Shelomith, Haziel, and Haran, three in total. These were the leaders of the families of Laadan.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Shimei were, Jahath, Zina, and Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.
verses.decoded: The sons of Shimei were Jahath, Zina, Jeush, and Beriah. These four were the sons of Shimei.

verses.kjv: And Jahath was the chief, and Zizah the second: but Jeush and Beriah had not many sons; therefore they were in one reckoning, according to their father’s house.
verses.decoded: Jahath was the leader, and Zizah was second; but Jeush and Beriah did not have many sons, so they were counted together as one group, according to their family line.

verses.kjv: The sons of Kohath; Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel, four.
verses.decoded: The sons of Kohath were Amram, Izhar, Hebron, and Uzziel—four in total.

verses.kjv: The sons of Amram; Aaron and Moses: and Aaron was separated, that he should sanctify the most holy things, he and his sons for ever, to burn incense before the Lord, to minister unto him, and to bless in his name for ever.
verses.decoded: The sons of Amram were Aaron and Moses; and Aaron was set apart so that he and his sons would always dedicate the most holy things, to burn incense before the LORD, to serve Him, and to bless in His name forever.

verses.kjv: Now concerning Moses the man of God, his sons were named of the tribe of Levi.
verses.decoded: Now regarding Moses, the man of God, his sons were listed from the tribe of Levi.

verses.kjv: The sons of Moses were, Gershom, and Eliezer.
verses.decoded: Moses' sons were Gershom and Eliezer.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the chief.
verses.decoded: Among the sons of Gershom, Shebuel was the leader.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Eliezer were, Rehabiah the chief. And Eliezer had none other sons; but the sons of Rehabiah were very many.
verses.decoded: The sons of Eliezer were led by Rehabiah as the chief. Eliezer had no other sons, but Rehabiah's sons were very numerous.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Izhar; Shelomith the chief.
verses.decoded: From the sons of Izhar; Shelomith was the leader.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.
verses.decoded: The sons of Hebron were Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah the first, and Jesiah the second.
verses.decoded: From the sons of Uzziel: Micah was the first, and Jesiah was the second.

verses.kjv: The sons of Merari; Mahli, and Mushi. The sons of Mahli; Eleazar, and Kish.
verses.decoded: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi. The sons of Mahli were Eleazar and Kish.

verses.kjv: And Eleazar died, and had no sons, but daughters: and their brethren the sons of Kish took them.
verses.decoded: Eleazar died and had no sons, only daughters; and their brothers, the sons of Kish, married them.

verses.kjv: The sons of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jeremoth, three.
verses.decoded: The sons of Mushi were Mahli, Eder, and Jeremoth; three in total.

verses.kjv: These were the sons of Levi after the house of their fathers; even the chief of the fathers, as they were counted by number of names by their polls, that did the work for the service of the house of the Lord, from the age of twenty years and upward.
verses.decoded: These were the sons of Levi according to their family groups; the leaders of the families were counted by name by their heads, who performed the work for the service of the house of the LORD, starting from the age of twenty years and older.

verses.kjv: For David said, The Lord God of Israel hath given rest unto his people, that they may dwell in Jerusalem for ever:
verses.decoded: For David said, The LORD God of Israel has given rest to his people, so that they may live in Jerusalem forever:

verses.kjv: And also unto the Levites; they shall no more carry the tabernacle, nor any vessels of it for the service thereof.
verses.decoded: And also to the Levites: they will no longer carry the tabernacle or any of its vessels for its service.

verses.kjv: For by the last words of David the Levites were numbered from twenty years old and above:
verses.decoded: Because of David's final instructions, the Levites were counted starting from twenty years old and older:

verses.kjv: Because their office was to wait on the sons of Aaron for the service of the house of the Lord, in the courts, and in the chambers, and in the purifying of all holy things, and the work of the service of the house of God;
verses.decoded: Because their duty was to assist the sons of Aaron in the service of the house of the LORD, in the courtyards, and in the rooms, and in the purification of all holy things, and in the work of serving the house of God;

verses.kjv: Both for the shewbread, and for the fine flour for meat offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for that which is baked in the pan, and for that which is fried, and for all manner of measure and size;
verses.decoded: Both for the showbread, and for the fine flour for the grain offering, and for the unleavened cakes, and for what is baked in the pan, and for what is fried, and for every kind of measure and size;

verses.kjv: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the Lord, and likewise at even;
verses.decoded: And to stand every morning to thank and praise the LORD, and also in the evening;

verses.kjv: And to offer all burnt sacrifices unto the Lord in the sabbaths, in the new moons, and on the set feasts, by number, according to the order commanded unto them, continually before the Lord:
verses.decoded: And to offer all burnt sacrifices to the LORD on the Sabbaths, on the new moons, and on the appointed festivals, according to the number and the order commanded to them, continually before the LORD.

verses.kjv: And that they should keep the charge of the tabernacle of the congregation, and the charge of the holy place, and the charge of the sons of Aaron their brethren, in the service of the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: And they were to be responsible for the care of the tabernacle of the assembly, the care of the holy place, and the care of the sons of Aaron their brothers, in the service of the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Now these are the divisions of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron; Nadab, and Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.
verses.decoded: These are the groups of the sons of Aaron. The sons of Aaron were Nadab, Abihu, Eleazar, and Ithamar.

verses.kjv: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father, and had no children: therefore Eleazar and Ithamar executed the priest’s office.
verses.decoded: But Nadab and Abihu died before their father and had no children; so Eleazar and Ithamar performed the duties of the priest.

verses.kjv: And David distributed them, both Zadok of the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech of the sons of Ithamar, according to their offices in their service.
verses.decoded: And David assigned their duties, both Zadok from the sons of Eleazar, and Ahimelech from the sons of Ithamar, according to their roles in their service.

verses.kjv: And there were more chief men found of the sons of Eleazar than of the sons of Ithamar; and thus were they divided. Among the sons of Eleazar there were sixteen chief men of the house of their fathers, and eight among the sons of Ithamar according to the house of their fathers.
verses.decoded: There were more leaders found among the sons of Eleazar than among the sons of Ithamar; and this is how they were divided. Among the sons of Eleazar, there were sixteen leaders from their family houses, and among the sons of Ithamar, there were eight leaders according to their family houses.

verses.kjv: Thus were they divided by lot, one sort with another; for the governors of the sanctuary, and governors of the house of God, were of the sons of Eleazar, and of the sons of Ithamar.
verses.decoded: So they were divided by casting lots, one group with another; because the leaders of the sanctuary and leaders of the house of God were from the sons of Eleazar and from the sons of Ithamar.

verses.kjv: And Shemaiah the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, wrote them before the king, and the princes, and Zadok the priest, and Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and before the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites: one principal household being taken for Eleazar, and one taken for Ithamar.
verses.decoded: Shemaiah, the son of Nethaneel the scribe, one of the Levites, wrote them down in the presence of the king, the princes, Zadok the priest, Ahimelech the son of Abiathar, and the leaders of the families of the priests and Levites: one main family was assigned to Eleazar, and one was assigned to Ithamar.

verses.kjv: Now the first lot came forth to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,
verses.decoded: Now the first lot was given to Jehoiarib, the second to Jedaiah,

verses.kjv: The third to Harim, the fourth to Seorim,
verses.decoded: The third group was assigned to Harim, and the fourth group was assigned to Seorim,

verses.kjv: The fifth to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,
verses.decoded: The fifth was assigned to Malchijah, the sixth to Mijamin,

verses.kjv: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,
verses.decoded: The seventh to Hakkoz, the eighth to Abijah,

verses.kjv: The ninth to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,
verses.decoded: The ninth was given to Jeshua, the tenth to Shecaniah,

verses.kjv: The eleventh to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,
verses.decoded: The eleventh was given to Eliashib, the twelfth to Jakim,

verses.kjv: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,
verses.decoded: The thirteenth to Huppah, the fourteenth to Jeshebeab,

verses.kjv: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,
verses.decoded: The fifteenth to Bilgah, the sixteenth to Immer,

verses.kjv: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,
verses.decoded: The seventeenth to Hezir, the eighteenth to Aphses,

verses.kjv: The nineteenth to Pethahiah, the twentieth to Jehezekel,
verses.decoded: The nineteenth was assigned to Pethahiah, the twentieth was assigned to Jehezekel,

verses.kjv: The one and twentieth to Jachin, the two and twentieth to Gamul,
verses.decoded: The twenty-first to Jachin, the twenty-second to Gamul,

verses.kjv: The three and twentieth to Delaiah, the four and twentieth to Maaziah.
verses.decoded: The twenty-third to Delaiah, the twenty-fourth to Maaziah.

verses.kjv: These were the orderings of them in their service to come into the house of the Lord, according to their manner, under Aaron their father, as the Lord God of Israel had commanded him.
verses.decoded: These were their arrangements for serving when they entered the house of the LORD, according to their assigned duties, under Aaron their father, as the LORD God of Israel had commanded him.

verses.kjv: And the rest of the sons of Levi were these: Of the sons of Amram; Shubael: of the sons of Shubael; Jehdeiah.
verses.decoded: The remaining sons of Levi were these: From the sons of Amram, Shubael; from the sons of Shubael, Jehdeiah.

verses.kjv: Concerning Rehabiah: of the sons of Rehabiah, the first was Isshiah.
verses.decoded: About Rehabiah: the first son of Rehabiah was Isshiah.

verses.kjv: Of the Izharites; Shelomoth: of the sons of Shelomoth; Jahath.
verses.decoded: From the Izharites: Shelomoth; from the sons of Shelomoth: Jahath.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Hebron; Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, Jekameam the fourth.
verses.decoded: The sons of Hebron were Jeriah the first, Amariah the second, Jahaziel the third, and Jekameam the fourth.

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Uzziel; Michah: of the sons of Michah; Shamir.
verses.decoded: From the sons of Uzziel: Michah; from the sons of Michah: Shamir.

verses.kjv: The brother of Michah was Isshiah: of the sons of Isshiah; Zechariah.
verses.decoded: Isshiah was the brother of Michah; Zechariah was one of the sons of Isshiah.

verses.kjv: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi: the sons of Jaaziah; Beno.
verses.decoded: The sons of Merari were Mahli and Mushi; the sons of Jaaziah were Beno.

verses.kjv: The sons of Merari by Jaaziah; Beno, and Shoham, and Zaccur, and Ibri.
verses.decoded: The sons of Merari through Jaaziah were Beno, Shoham, Zaccur, and Ibri.

verses.kjv: Of Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.
verses.decoded: From Mahli came Eleazar, who had no sons.

verses.kjv: Concerning Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.
verses.decoded: About Kish: the son of Kish was Jerahmeel.

verses.kjv: The sons also of Mushi; Mahli, and Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the sons of the Levites after the house of their fathers.
verses.decoded: The sons of Mushi were Mahli, Eder, and Jerimoth. These were the Levite descendants according to their family lines.

verses.kjv: These likewise cast lots over against their brethren the sons of Aaron in the presence of David the king, and Zadok, and Ahimelech, and the chief of the fathers of the priests and Levites, even the principal fathers over against their younger brethren.
verses.decoded: These also cast lots opposite their brothers, the sons of Aaron, in the presence of King David, Zadok, Ahimelech, and the leaders of the fathers of the priests and Levites, the senior fathers opposite their younger brothers.

verses.kjv: Moreover David and the captains of the host separated to the service of the sons of Asaph, and of Heman, and of Jeduthun, who should prophesy with harps, with psalteries, and with cymbals: and the number of the workmen according to their service was:
verses.decoded: Furthermore, David and the commanders of the army assigned the sons of Asaph, Heman, and Jeduthun to the service of prophesying with harps, psalteries, and cymbals. The number of the workers according to their service was:

verses.kjv: Of the sons of Asaph; Zaccur, and Joseph, and Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph under the hands of Asaph, which prophesied according to the order of the king.
verses.decoded: From the sons of Asaph: Zaccur, Joseph, Nethaniah, and Asarelah, the sons of Asaph who were under the authority of Asaph, who prophesied according to the king's command.

verses.kjv: Of Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun; Gedaliah, and Zeri, and Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six, under the hands of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied with a harp, to give thanks and to praise the Lord.
verses.decoded: From Jeduthun: the sons of Jeduthun were Gedaliah, Zeri, Jeshaiah, Hashabiah, and Mattithiah, six in total, under the direction of their father Jeduthun, who prophesied by playing a harp to give thanks and to praise the LORD.

verses.kjv: Of Heman: the sons of Heman; Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, and Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth:
verses.decoded: From Heman: the sons of Heman were Bukkiah, Mattaniah, Uzziel, Shebuel, and Jerimoth, Hananiah, Hanani, Eliathah, Giddalti, Romamti-ezer, Joshbekashah, Mallothi, Hothir, and Mahazioth.

verses.kjv: All these were the sons of Heman the king’s seer in the words of God, to lift up the horn. And God gave to Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.
verses.decoded: All these were the sons of Heman, the king’s prophet in the messages from God, to raise the power. And God gave Heman fourteen sons and three daughters.

verses.kjv: All these were under the hands of their father for song in the house of the Lord, with cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, according to the king’s order to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.
verses.decoded: All these were supervised by their father for singing in the house of the LORD, using cymbals, psalteries, and harps, for the service of the house of God, following the king’s command to Asaph, Jeduthun, and Heman.

verses.kjv: So the number of them, with their brethren that were instructed in the songs of the Lord, even all that were cunning, was two hundred fourscore and eight.
verses.decoded: The total number of them, along with their brothers who were trained in the songs of the LORD, all of whom were skilled, was two hundred eighty-eight.

verses.kjv: And they cast lots, ward against ward, as well the small as the great, the teacher as the scholar.
verses.decoded: And they cast lots, group against group, both the young and the old, the teacher and the student.

verses.kjv: Now the first lot came forth for Asaph to Joseph: the second to Gedaliah, who with his brethren and sons were twelve:
verses.decoded: Now the first lot was assigned to Asaph for Joseph; the second was assigned to Gedaliah, who, along with his brothers and sons, totaled twelve.

verses.kjv: The third to Zaccur, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The third was Zaccur; he, his sons, and his brothers were twelve in number.

verses.kjv: The fourth to Izri, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The fourth was Izri; he, his sons, and his brothers were twelve in total.

verses.kjv: The fifth to Nethaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The fifth was Nethaniah; he, his sons, and his brothers were twelve in total.

verses.kjv: The sixth to Bukkiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The sixth was Bukkiah; he, his sons, and his brothers were twelve in total.

verses.kjv: The seventh to Jesharelah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The seventh was Jesharelah; he, his sons, and his brothers were twelve in total.

verses.kjv: The eighth to Jeshaiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The eighth was Jeshaiah; he, his sons, and his brothers were twelve in total.

verses.kjv: The ninth to Mattaniah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The ninth was Mattaniah; he, his sons, and his brothers were twelve in total.

verses.kjv: The tenth to Shimei, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The tenth group was assigned to Shimei; he, his sons, and his brothers were twelve in total.

verses.kjv: The eleventh to Azareel, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The eleventh was Azareel; he, his sons, and his brothers were twelve in total.

verses.kjv: The twelfth to Hashabiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The twelfth was Hashabiah, he, his sons, and his brothers, twelve in total:

verses.kjv: The thirteenth to Shubael, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The thirteenth was Shubael; he, his sons, and his brothers were twelve in number.

verses.kjv: The fourteenth to Mattithiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The fourteenth was Mattithiah, he, his sons, and his brothers, were twelve in total.

verses.kjv: The fifteenth to Jeremoth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The fifteenth was assigned to Jeremoth; he, his sons, and his brothers were twelve in number.

verses.kjv: The sixteenth to Hananiah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The sixteenth belonged to Hananiah; he, his sons, and his brothers were twelve in total.

verses.kjv: The seventeenth to Joshbekashah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The seventeenth was Joshbekashah; he, his sons, and his brothers were twelve in total.

verses.kjv: The eighteenth to Hanani, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The eighteenth was Hanani, and he, his sons, and his brothers were twelve in total.

verses.kjv: The nineteenth to Mallothi, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The nineteenth was Mallothi; he, his sons, and his brothers were twelve in total.

verses.kjv: The twentieth to Eliathah, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The twentieth group was assigned to Eliathah; he, his sons, and his brothers were twelve in total.

verses.kjv: The one and twentieth to Hothir, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The twenty-first was Hothir; he, his sons, and his brothers were twelve in total.

verses.kjv: The two and twentieth to Giddalti, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The twenty-second was Giddalti; he, his sons, and his brothers were twelve.

verses.kjv: The three and twentieth to Mahazioth, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve:
verses.decoded: The twenty-third was Mahazioth; he, his sons, and his brothers were twelve in total.

verses.kjv: The four and twentieth to Romamti-ezer, he, his sons, and his brethren, were twelve.
verses.decoded: The twenty-fourth was Romamti-ezer; he, his sons, and his brothers were twelve.

verses.kjv: Concerning the divisions of the porters: Of the Korhites was Meshelemiah the son of Kore, of the sons of Asaph.
verses.decoded: About the groups of gatekeepers: Among the Korhites was Meshelemiah, the son of Kore, who was from the descendants of Asaph.

verses.kjv: And the sons of Meshelemiah were, Zechariah the firstborn, Jediael the second, Zebadiah the third, Jathniel the fourth,
verses.decoded: The sons of Meshelemiah were Zechariah, the firstborn; Jediael, the second; Zebadiah, the third; and Jathniel, the fourth.

verses.kjv: Elam the fifth, Jehohanan the sixth, Elioenai the seventh.
verses.decoded: Elam was the fifth, Jehohanan was the sixth, Elioenai was the seventh.

verses.kjv: Moreover the sons of Obed-edom were, Shemaiah the firstborn, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, and Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth,
verses.decoded: Also, the sons of Obed-edom were Shemaiah the oldest, Jehozabad the second, Joah the third, Sacar the fourth, and Nethaneel the fifth.

verses.kjv: Ammiel the sixth, Issachar the seventh, Peulthai the eighth: for God blessed him.
verses.decoded: Ammiel was the sixth, Issachar was the seventh, Peulthai was the eighth, because God blessed him.

verses.kjv: Also unto Shemaiah his son were sons born, that ruled throughout the house of their father: for they were mighty men of valour.
verses.decoded: Also, Shemaiah his son had sons who ruled over their father's household, because they were strong and courageous men.

verses.kjv: The sons of Shemaiah; Othni, and Rephael, and Obed, Elzabad, whose brethren were strong men, Elihu, and Semachiah.
verses.decoded: The sons of Shemaiah were Othni, Rephael, Obed, and Elzabad, whose brothers were strong men named Elihu and Semachiah.

verses.kjv: All these of the sons of Obed-edom: they and their sons and their brethren, able men for strength for the service, were threescore and two of Obed-edom.
verses.decoded: All these were from the sons of Obed-edom: they, their sons, and their brothers, strong and capable men for the service, were sixty-two in total from Obed-edom.

verses.kjv: And Meshelemiah had sons and brethren, strong men, eighteen.
verses.decoded: Meshelemiah had sons and brothers, eighteen strong men.

verses.kjv: Also Hosah, of the children of Merari, had sons; Simri the chief, (for though he was not the firstborn, yet his father made him the chief;)
verses.decoded: Also Hosah, from the descendants of Merari, had sons; Simri was the leader, because even though he was not the oldest son, his father appointed him as the leader.

verses.kjv: Hilkiah the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth: all the sons and brethren of Hosah were thirteen.
verses.decoded: Hilkiah was the second, Tebaliah the third, Zechariah the fourth; all the sons and brothers of Hosah were thirteen.

verses.kjv: Among these were the divisions of the porters, even among the chief men, having wards one against another, to minister in the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Among these were the groups of gatekeepers, even among the leaders, each assigned to opposite shifts to serve in the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And they cast lots, as well the small as the great, according to the house of their fathers, for every gate.
verses.decoded: They cast lots, both the young and the old, according to their family groups, for each gate.

verses.kjv: And the lot eastward fell to Shelemiah. Then for Zechariah his son, a wise counseller, they cast lots; and his lot came out northward.
verses.decoded: The lot for the east side was given to Shelemiah. Then, for Zechariah his son, a wise advisor, they cast lots; and his lot was for the north side.

verses.kjv: To Obed-edom southward; and to his sons the house of Asuppim.
verses.decoded: To Obed-edom on the south side; and to his sons, the house of Asuppim.

verses.kjv: To Shuppim and Hosah the lot came forth westward, with the gate Shallecheth, by the causeway of the going up, ward against ward.
verses.decoded: The lot was assigned to Shuppim and Hosah for the west side, along with the Shallecheth gate, by the ramp leading up, guarding side by side.

verses.kjv: Eastward were six Levites, northward four a day, southward four a day, and toward Asuppim two and two.
verses.decoded: On the east side there were six Levites, on the north side four during the day, on the south side four during the day, and toward Asuppim two by two.

verses.kjv: At Parbar westward, four at the causeway, and two at Parbar.
verses.decoded: At Parbar on the west side, four were at the causeway, and two were at Parbar.

verses.kjv: These are the divisions of the porters among the sons of Kore, and among the sons of Merari.
verses.decoded: These are the groups of gatekeepers among the sons of Kore and among the sons of Merari.

verses.kjv: And of the Levites, Ahijah was over the treasures of the house of God, and over the treasures of the dedicated things.
verses.decoded: Among the Levites, Ahijah was in charge of the treasures of the house of God and the treasures of the dedicated items.

verses.kjv: As concerning the sons of Laadan; the sons of the Gershonite Laadan, chief fathers, even of Laadan the Gershonite, were Jehieli.
verses.decoded: Regarding the sons of Laadan; the sons of Laadan the Gershonite, who were leaders, were Jehieli.

verses.kjv: The sons of Jehieli; Zetham, and Joel his brother, which were over the treasures of the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: The sons of Jehieli were Zetham and Joel his brother, who were in charge of the treasures of the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: Of the Amramites, and the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:
verses.decoded: From the Amramites, the Izharites, the Hebronites, and the Uzzielites:

verses.kjv: And Shebuel the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was ruler of the treasures.
verses.decoded: And Shebuel, the son of Gershom, the son of Moses, was the manager of the treasures.

verses.kjv: And his brethren by Eliezer; Rehabiah his son, and Jeshaiah his son, and Joram his son, and Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.
verses.decoded: And his brothers through Eliezer: Rehabiah his son, Jeshaiah his son, Joram his son, Zichri his son, and Shelomith his son.

verses.kjv: Which Shelomith and his brethren were over all the treasures of the dedicated things, which David the king, and the chief fathers, the captains over thousands and hundreds, and the captains of the host, had dedicated.
verses.decoded: Shelomith and his brothers were in charge of all the treasures of the dedicated items, which King David, the leading officials, the commanders of thousands and hundreds, and the commanders of the army had dedicated.

verses.kjv: Out of the spoils won in battles did they dedicate to maintain the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: They dedicated part of the spoils taken in battles to support the maintenance of the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And all that Samuel the seer, and Saul the son of Kish, and Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah, had dedicated; and whosoever had dedicated any thing, it was under the hand of Shelomith, and of his brethren.
verses.decoded: And everything that Samuel the seer, Saul the son of Kish, Abner the son of Ner, and Joab the son of Zeruiah had dedicated; and whoever had dedicated anything, it was under the authority of Shelomith and his brothers.

verses.kjv: Of the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were for the outward business over Israel, for officers and judges.
verses.decoded: From the Izharites, Chenaniah and his sons were responsible for the external affairs over Israel, serving as officers and judges.

verses.kjv: And of the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brethren, men of valour, a thousand and seven hundred, were officers among them of Israel on this side Jordan westward in all the business of the Lord, and in the service of the king.
verses.decoded: And from the Hebronites, Hashabiah and his brothers, brave men, one thousand seven hundred, were officers among the people of Israel on this side of the Jordan River, westward, in all the work of the LORD and in the service of the king.

verses.kjv: Among the Hebronites was Jerijah the chief, even among the Hebronites, according to the generations of his fathers. In the fortieth year of the reign of David they were sought for, and there were found among them mighty men of valour at Jazer of Gilead.
verses.decoded: Jerijah was the leader among the Hebronites, following the family lines of his ancestors. In the fortieth year of King David's reign, they were called upon, and among them were found brave and strong men at Jazer in Gilead.

verses.kjv: And his brethren, men of valour, were two thousand and seven hundred chief fathers, whom king David made rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter pertaining to God, and affairs of the king.
verses.decoded: And his brothers, brave men, were two thousand seven hundred leaders, whom King David appointed as rulers over the Reubenites, the Gadites, and the half tribe of Manasseh, for every matter related to God and the king's affairs.

verses.kjv: Now the children of Israel after their number, to wit, the chief fathers and captains of thousands and hundreds, and their officers that served the king in any matter of the courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, of every course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.decoded: Now the people of Israel, according to their number, that is, the leaders and commanders of thousands and hundreds, and their officers who served the king in any matter of the divisions, who came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year, each division had twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: Over the first course for the first month was Jashobeam the son of Zabdiel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.decoded: In charge of the first division for the first month was Jashobeam, the son of Zabdiel; and in his division there were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: Of the children of Perez was the chief of all the captains of the host for the first month.
verses.decoded: The leader of all the army captains for the first month was from the descendants of Perez.

verses.kjv: And over the course of the second month was Dodai an Ahohite, and of his course was Mikloth also the ruler: in his course likewise were twenty and four thousand.
verses.decoded: In charge of the second month was Dodai the Ahohite, and Mikloth was also the leader of his group: in his group there were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: The third captain of the host for the third month was Benaiah the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.decoded: The third commander of the army for the third month was Benaiah, the son of Jehoiada, a chief priest, and under his command were twenty-four thousand men.

verses.kjv: This is that Benaiah, who was mighty among the thirty, and above the thirty: and in his course was Ammizabad his son.
verses.decoded: This is Benaiah, who was powerful among the thirty warriors and was greater than the thirty; his son Ammizabad was in his group.

verses.kjv: The fourth captain for the fourth month was Asahel the brother of Joab, and Zebadiah his son after him: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.decoded: The fourth leader for the fourth month was Asahel, the brother of Joab, and after him, his son Zebadiah: and in his group were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: The fifth captain for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.decoded: The fifth commander for the fifth month was Shamhuth the Izrahite, and in his division there were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: The sixth captain for the sixth month was Ira the son of Ikkesh the Tekoite: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.decoded: The sixth commander for the sixth month was Ira, the son of Ikkesh from Tekoa, and under his command were twenty-four thousand men.

verses.kjv: The seventh captain for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.decoded: The seventh commander for the seventh month was Helez the Pelonite, from the descendants of Ephraim, and in his division there were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: The eighth captain for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.decoded: The eighth commander for the eighth month was Sibbecai the Hushathite, from the Zarhites, and under his command were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: The ninth captain for the ninth month was Abiezer the Anetothite, of the Benjamites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.decoded: The ninth commander for the ninth month was Abiezer from Anetoth, a Benjaminite; and under his command were twenty-four thousand men.

verses.kjv: The tenth captain for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, of the Zarhites: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.decoded: The tenth commander for the tenth month was Maharai the Netophathite, from the Zarhites, and under his command were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: The eleventh captain for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, of the children of Ephraim: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.decoded: The commander for the eleventh month was Benaiah the Pirathonite, from the descendants of Ephraim, and in his division there were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: The twelfth captain for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, of Othniel: and in his course were twenty and four thousand.
verses.decoded: The twelfth commander for the twelfth month was Heldai the Netophathite, from Othniel, and in his division there were twenty-four thousand.

verses.kjv: Furthermore over the tribes of Israel: the ruler of the Reubenites was Eliezer the son of Zichri: of the Simeonites, Shephatiah the son of Maachah:
verses.decoded: Also, over the tribes of Israel: the leader of the Reubenites was Eliezer, the son of Zichri; over the Simeonites, Shephatiah, the son of Maachah.

verses.kjv: Of the Levites, Hashabiah the son of Kemuel: of the Aaronites, Zadok:
verses.decoded: Among the Levites, Hashabiah, the son of Kemuel; among the Aaronites, Zadok.

verses.kjv: Of Judah, Elihu, one of the brethren of David: of Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:
verses.decoded: For Judah, Elihu, one of David's brothers; for Issachar, Omri the son of Michael:

verses.kjv: Of Zebulun, Ishmaiah the son of Obadiah: of Naphtali, Jerimoth the son of Azriel:
verses.decoded: For Zebulun, Ishmaiah, the son of Obadiah; for Naphtali, Jerimoth, the son of Azriel.

verses.kjv: Of the children of Ephraim, Hoshea the son of Azaziah: of the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel the son of Pedaiah:
verses.decoded: From the descendants of Ephraim, Hoshea, the son of Azaziah; from the half tribe of Manasseh, Joel, the son of Pedaiah.

verses.kjv: Of the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo the son of Zechariah: of Benjamin, Jaasiel the son of Abner:
verses.decoded: For the half tribe of Manasseh in Gilead, Iddo, the son of Zechariah; for Benjamin, Jaasiel, the son of Abner.

verses.kjv: Of Dan, Azareel the son of Jeroham. These were the princes of the tribes of Israel.
verses.decoded: From the tribe of Dan, Azareel, the son of Jeroham. These were the leaders of the tribes of Israel.

verses.kjv: But David took not the number of them from twenty years old and under: because the Lord had said he would increase Israel like to the stars of the heavens.
verses.decoded: But David did not count those who were twenty years old and younger, because the LORD had said he would make Israel as numerous as the stars in the sky.

verses.kjv: Joab the son of Zeruiah began to number, but he finished not, because there fell wrath for it against Israel; neither was the number put in the account of the chronicles of king David.
verses.decoded: Joab, the son of Zeruiah, began to count the people, but he did not finish because God's anger came against Israel because of it; and the number was not recorded in the official records of King David.

verses.kjv: And over the king’s treasures was Azmaveth the son of Adiel: and over the storehouses in the fields, in the cities, and in the villages, and in the castles, was Jehonathan the son of Uzziah:
verses.decoded: Azmaveth, the son of Adiel, was in charge of the king’s treasures; and Jehonathan, the son of Uzziah, was in charge of the storehouses in the fields, cities, villages, and castles.

verses.kjv: And over them that did the work of the field for tillage of the ground was Ezri the son of Chelub:
verses.decoded: And the person in charge of those who worked the fields to cultivate the land was Ezri, the son of Chelub.

verses.kjv: And over the vineyards was Shimei the Ramathite: over the increase of the vineyards for the wine cellars was Zabdi the Shiphmite:
verses.decoded: Shimei the Ramathite was in charge of the vineyards; Zabdi the Shiphmite was in charge of the produce from the vineyards for the wine cellars.

verses.kjv: And over the olive trees and the sycomore trees that were in the low plains was Baal-hanan the Gederite: and over the cellars of oil was Joash:
verses.decoded: Baal-hanan the Gederite was in charge of the olive trees and the sycamore trees in the low plains, and Joash was in charge of the storage rooms for oil.

verses.kjv: And over the herds that fed in Sharon was Shitrai the Sharonite: and over the herds that were in the valleys was Shaphat the son of Adlai:
verses.decoded: Shitrai the Sharonite was in charge of the herds that grazed in Sharon, and Shaphat, the son of Adlai, was in charge of the herds in the valleys.

verses.kjv: Over the camels also was Obil the Ishmaelite: and over the asses was Jehdeiah the Meronothite:
verses.decoded: Obil the Ishmaelite was in charge of the camels, and Jehdeiah the Meronothite was in charge of the donkeys.

verses.kjv: And over the flocks was Jaziz the Hagerite. All these were the rulers of the substance which was king David’s.
verses.decoded: And Jaziz the Hagerite was in charge of the flocks. All of these were the managers of the wealth that belonged to King David.

verses.kjv: Also Jonathan David’s uncle was a counseller, a wise man, and a scribe: and Jehiel the son of Hachmoni was with the king’s sons:
verses.decoded: Also, Jonathan, David’s uncle, was an advisor, a wise man, and a scribe; and Jehiel, the son of Hachmoni, was with the king’s sons.

verses.kjv: And Ahithophel was the king’s counseller: and Hushai the Archite was the king’s companion:
verses.decoded: And Ahithophel was the king’s advisor, and Hushai the Archite was the king’s close friend.

verses.kjv: And after Ahithophel was Jehoiada the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar: and the general of the king’s army was Joab.
verses.decoded: After Ahithophel came Jehoiada, the son of Benaiah, and Abiathar; and the commander of the king’s army was Joab.

verses.kjv: And David assembled all the princes of Israel, the princes of the tribes, and the captains of the companies that ministered to the king by course, and the captains over the thousands, and captains over the hundreds, and the stewards over all the substance and possession of the king, and of his sons, with the officers, and with the mighty men, and with all the valiant men, unto Jerusalem.
verses.decoded: David gathered all the leaders of Israel, the leaders of the tribes, the commanders of the groups who served the king in rotation, the commanders over thousands, the commanders over hundreds, the stewards over all the wealth and possessions of the king and his sons, along with the officials, the mighty warriors, and all the brave men, to Jerusalem.

verses.kjv: Then David the king stood up upon his feet, and said, Hear me, my brethren, and my people: As for me, I had in mine heart to build an house of rest for the ark of the covenant of the Lord, and for the footstool of our God, and had made ready for the building:
verses.decoded: Then King David stood up and said, Listen to me, my brothers and my people: As for me, I intended in my heart to build a resting place for the ark of the covenant of the LORD, and for the footstool of our God, and I had prepared for the construction:

verses.kjv: But God said unto me, Thou shalt not build an house for my name, because thou hast been a man of war, and hast shed blood.
verses.decoded: But God said to me, You will not build a house for my name, because you have been a warrior and have shed blood.

verses.kjv: Howbeit the Lord God of Israel chose me before all the house of my father to be king over Israel for ever: for he hath chosen Judah to be the ruler; and of the house of Judah, the house of my father; and among the sons of my father he liked me to make me king over all Israel:
verses.decoded: However, the LORD God of Israel chose me above all my family to be king over Israel forever, because he chose Judah to be the leader; and from the tribe of Judah, my family; and among my family members, he wanted me to be king over all Israel.

verses.kjv: And of all my sons, (for the Lord hath given me many sons,) he hath chosen Solomon my son to sit upon the throne of the kingdom of the Lord over Israel.
verses.decoded: And among all my sons, (because the LORD has given me many sons,) he has chosen Solomon my son to sit on the throne of the kingdom of the LORD over Israel.

verses.kjv: And he said unto me, Solomon thy son, he shall build my house and my courts: for I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.
verses.decoded: And he said to me, Solomon your son, he will build my house and my courts: because I have chosen him to be my son, and I will be his father.

verses.kjv: Moreover I will establish his kingdom for ever, if he be constant to do my commandments and my judgments, as at this day.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, I will establish his kingdom forever, if he remains faithful to obey my commandments and my laws, just as he does today.

verses.kjv: Now therefore in the sight of all Israel the congregation of the Lord, and in the audience of our God, keep and seek for all the commandments of the Lord your God: that ye may possess this good land, and leave it for an inheritance for your children after you for ever.
verses.decoded: So now, in front of all Israel, the assembly of the LORD, and in the presence of our God, obey and look for all the commandments of the LORD your God, so that you may own this good land and leave it as an inheritance for your children after you forever.

verses.kjv: And thou, Solomon my son, know thou the God of thy father, and serve him with a perfect heart and with a willing mind: for the Lord searcheth all hearts, and understandeth all the imaginations of the thoughts: if thou seek him, he will be found of thee; but if thou forsake him, he will cast thee off for ever.
verses.decoded: And you, Solomon my son, know the God of your father, and serve him with a sincere heart and a willing mind: for the LORD searches all hearts and understands all the intentions of the thoughts: if you seek him, you will find him; but if you abandon him, he will reject you forever.

verses.kjv: Take heed now; for the Lord hath chosen thee to build an house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.
verses.decoded: Pay attention now; because the LORD has chosen you to build a house for the sanctuary: be strong, and do it.

verses.kjv: Then David gave to Solomon his son the pattern of the porch, and of the houses thereof, and of the treasuries thereof, and of the upper chambers thereof, and of the inner parlours thereof, and of the place of the mercy seat,
verses.decoded: Then David gave to Solomon his son the design of the porch, and of its rooms, and of its treasuries, and of its upper rooms, and of its inner chambers, and of the place of the mercy seat,

verses.kjv: And the pattern of all that he had by the spirit, of the courts of the house of the Lord, and of all the chambers round about, of the treasuries of the house of God, and of the treasuries of the dedicated things:
verses.decoded: And the design of everything he had by the Spirit, including the courts of the house of the LORD, all the surrounding rooms, the treasuries of the house of God, and the treasuries of the dedicated items:

verses.kjv: Also for the courses of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work of the service of the house of the Lord, and for all the vessels of service in the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: Also for the groups of the priests and the Levites, and for all the work involved in serving in the house of the LORD, and for all the tools used in service in the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: He gave of gold by weight for things of gold, for all instruments of all manner of service; silver also for all instruments of silver by weight, for all instruments of every kind of service:
verses.decoded: He provided gold measured by weight for all gold items, for every kind of service instrument; he also provided silver measured by weight for all silver instruments, for every kind of service instrument.

verses.kjv: Even the weight for the candlesticks of gold, and for their lamps of gold, by weight for every candlestick, and for the lamps thereof: and for the candlesticks of silver by weight, both for the candlestick, and also for the lamps thereof, according to the use of every candlestick.
verses.decoded: Also the weight for the gold candlesticks and their gold lamps, the weight for each candlestick and its lamps; and for the silver candlesticks by weight, both for the candlestick and its lamps, according to the use of each candlestick.

verses.kjv: And by weight he gave gold for the tables of shewbread, for every table; and likewise silver for the tables of silver:
verses.decoded: He gave gold by weight for the bread tables, for each table; and also silver for the silver tables.

verses.kjv: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, and the bowls, and the cups: and for the golden basons he gave gold by weight for every bason; and likewise silver by weight for every bason of silver:
verses.decoded: Also pure gold for the fleshhooks, the bowls, and the cups; and for the golden basins, he gave gold by weight for each basin; and similarly silver by weight for each silver basin.

verses.kjv: And for the altar of incense refined gold by weight; and gold for the pattern of the chariot of the cherubims, that spread out their wings, and covered the ark of the covenant of the Lord.
verses.decoded: And for the altar of incense, refined gold measured by weight; and gold for the design of the chariot of the cherubim, who spread out their wings and covered the ark of the covenant of the LORD.

verses.kjv: All this, said David, the Lord made me understand in writing by his hand upon me, even all the works of this pattern.
verses.decoded: David said, The LORD made me understand all of this in writing by his hand upon me, including all the details of this design.

verses.kjv: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and of good courage, and do it: fear not, nor be dismayed: for the Lord God, even my God, will be with thee; he will not fail thee, nor forsake thee, until thou hast finished all the work for the service of the house of the Lord.
verses.decoded: And David said to Solomon his son, Be strong and courageous, and do it; do not be afraid or discouraged, because the LORD God, my God, will be with you; he will not fail you or abandon you until you have finished all the work for the service of the house of the LORD.

verses.kjv: And, behold, the courses of the priests and the Levites, even they shall be with thee for all the service of the house of God: and there shall be with thee for all manner of workmanship every willing skilful man, for any manner of service: also the princes and all the people will be wholly at thy commandment.
verses.decoded: Look, the groups of the priests and the Levites will be with you for all the work of the house of God. Also, every willing and skilled man will be with you for every kind of work, for any kind of service. The leaders and all the people will be completely under your command.

verses.kjv: Furthermore David the king said unto all the congregation, Solomon my son, whom alone God hath chosen, is yet young and tender, and the work is great: for the palace is not for man, but for the Lord God.
verses.decoded: Furthermore, King David said to all the assembly, Solomon my son, whom God alone has chosen, is still young and inexperienced, and the work is great; for the palace is not for man, but for the LORD God.
